**Head of Physical Education (Whole School \- Male)**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor is looking to appoint an outstanding Head of Physical Education (Whole School \- Male) to join a well\-established, supportive team in a highly successful and expanding school.
   

  

**The closing date for applications 31st May 2026\.**
**The start date for this role is 1st August 2026\.**
**About You**
 You are an outstanding team leader with the track record for developing a vision for excellence and continual improvement. You excel in leading and managing people by creating a culture where colleagues are both supported and challenged to deliver the best possible learning experience for students. You can develop a highly motivated team by nurturing positive working relationships built on respect, trust, support, and recognition. You lead improvement through rigorous self\-evaluation of department performance and use quality assurance feedback to identify improvement priorities moving forward. You demonstrate excellent management skills such as resource management, curriculum planning, data analysis, performance tracking, task delegation, organisation of meetings and creating teacher timetables.
   

  

 You lead a learning culture where students are supported, challenged, and inspired to be the best they can be \- students in classes across the department will believe there are no limits to what can be achieved. Your excellent motivation and communication skills enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within all lessons across the department.
   

  

 Receptive to feedback and ready to embrace change, you will be keen to share best practice with colleagues and peers. As a strong ambassador for the school, you will be able to develop new ways to engage students and parents across both our school (NAISAK), and the wider Nord Anglia Education communities. Your strong motivation and communication skills will also enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within the classroom.
   

  

**You Will Have The Following**
* university degree in your specialist subject
* teaching qualification
* substantial Secondary level teaching experience, and knowledge of the Physical Education National curriculum, and IGCSE and A Level curriculums


 You will also be able to meet visa\-related restrictions for Qatar, including possession of a Bachelor’s degree and a teaching qualification from a face\-to\-face (non\-online) course.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join our dynamic international education environment, where you will lead the delivery a fit\-for\-purpose curriculum, built on the UK National Curriculum and preparing students for external examinations at IGSCE/AS\-A levels. You will lead the development of a culture in which students are challenged to be ambitious learners and teachers are required to be innovative to enhance the student experience and outcomes. You will understand the diverse international language environment within our school community to manage effective curriculum programmes to not only teach Physical Education subject content but also continue to support English language development for students across all areas of the school curriculum. Developing a high\-quality extra\-curricular programme for sport and health is a key priority, with a dual\-focus on development\-for\-all and competition.
   

  

 Your educational philosophy will equip you to meet the needs of all learners and be able to teach students with a range of prior achievement, knowledge, and skills. Your expertise and planning adaptability will allow you to map out pathways for all students to progress in your subject, creating opportunities for all learners to achieve success based on individualised targets. You will contribute to good practice by demonstrating a collegiate approach to departmental development and sharing strategies with colleagues.
   

  

 As Head of Physical Education, you will be responsible for leading the planning, delivery and evaluation of the curriculum, teaching and learning, assessment, reporting, student behaviour, and professional development of teachers across the Physical Education department.
   

  

 Please refer to the job description of the role for the following information:
   

  

* Job purpose
* Reporting to

**About Our School**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK) is a highly successful, growing school with a committed and inspirational team of teaching professionals at its heart. Our close\-knit, supportive team is proud to be at the centre of the local community, educating over 1350 young people aged 3\-18\. Secondary is 4\-form entry at Key Stage 3, and 3\-form entry in KS4 upwards, with approximately 530 students aged 11\-18\.
   

  

 Our school resides in the town of Al Khor, 35 minutes north of Doha (the capital of Qatar). We educate both local and expat students through a bespoke Secondary curriculum which draws on both the Physical Education National curriculum and the Qatar Ministry of Education curriculum.
   

  

 The school is focused on supporting students towards enhanced Physical Education language acquisition, excellent academic outcomes and outstanding learning experiences through STEAM, Performing Arts, extra\-curricular activities, residential trips, and international awards for wider achievement.
   

  

 The school prides itself on fostering student wellbeing, personalisation of learning and a strong sense of multiculturalism and global citizenship. We also have strong through\-school links and ensure consistent progression from Primary to Secondary to offer all our students a rewarding learning journey. The Primary school buildings have recently undergone further refurbishment following the opening of a brand\-new Secondary building in August 2019\. Our students also now benefit from a new 25m outdoor pool.
   

  

 To learn more about NAISAK, please visit
   

  

 https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/nais\-al\-khor
   

  

**About Nord Anglia Education**
 Each Nord Anglia Education school is unique in character and designed to meet the needs of its community. We are united by our philosophy, to be ambitious for our students, our people, and our family of schools. We believe that being part of our family of schools gives them a special advantage. Working together, we can achieve more than we can individually. Our schools have access to a wide range of resources and support to enhance their success. We also create unique opportunities to benefit our students and people, such as the Global Campus, Nord Anglia University, and our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King’s College London.

data.jd_text:
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* Directs, coaches, supports, supervises, and evaluates (with the Sous Chef) all direct reports.
* Must have excellent food knowledge and a full understanding of culinary terms.
* Must be able to read, understand, follow, and prepare company recipes by maintaining the quality and consistency in taste according to the instructions provided by the corporate office.
* Must be proficient in completing tasks, work efficiently and productively.
* Must be able to work in any section of a kitchen.
* Coordinate and supervise all team members assigned to their section, assign and delegate tasks accordingly.
* Undertake recipe reviews daily. Maintain recipe folders in immaculate condition.
* Responsible for follow\-through on any request within the area of responsibility received from the direct supervisor or manager on duty; this may include show plates, food samples and random food tastings.
* Control production levels and recommend ideas for improvements and better cost controlling.
* Prepare daily electronic food requisitions needed for his section production and countercheck deliveries for its accuracy; Report any discrepancies to his immediate supervisor.
* Must be able to oversee any main section (Sauce, Entremetier, Fish, Roast, Outlet CDP, Tournant and Cold Kitchen) and its entire food production.
* Maintain and ensure that Public Health are followed according to company standards and expectation (referring to US, Anvisa, Shipsan, Canadian, Australian etc.) and always followed within their section.
* Ensures that the HACCP program is carried out correctly.
* Maintains their assigned area in preparation for announced or unannounced United States Public Health type inspection either done by the Food \& Beverage Director or the actual inspectors.
* Reports for duty at assigned times, follows their supervisor’s instructions, and ensures that personal appearance, uniform, and personal hygiene are in accordance with the company’s rules and regulations.



  





**FINANCIAL RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* This position is responsible for cost containment through the proper use, handling and maintenance of records, reports, supplies and equipment.
* Identifies potential expense reductions through cost control.
* Analyzes operational problems and establishes controls.
* Reviews timesheets and forwards them to the Executive Chef for approval.
* May prepare a variety of reports and letters utilizing personal computer system and equipment.
* Ensures that items are requisitioned in correct quantities, within acceptable timeframes and in accordance with established control procedures.
* Conducts workstation spot checks to ensure items are correctly stored to minimize deterioration and waste.



  





**MOTIVATIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* Monitors and manages the various assigned workstation functions.
* Monitors the assignment of duties and responsibilities to their staff.
* Observes and evaluates staff and work procedures to ensure quality standards and service are met.
* Makes recommendations regarding personnel actions such as new hire requests and discharges, to ensure adequate and continuous staffing.
* Inspects workstations, work areas, equipment, etc. to ensure efficient service and conformance to standards.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION** 




  




* A minimum of 8 years in an upscale hotel, resort, cruise ship or convention banqueting service and at least 2 years as Chef de Partie (shipboard experience preferred).
* A culinary school degree is required.
* Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
* Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
* Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
* Knowledge of the principles and processes for providing personalized services including needs assessment techniques, quality service standards, alternative delivery systems, and guest satisfaction evaluation techniques.
* Strong planning, coaching, organizing, staffing, controlling, and evaluating skills.
* Intermediate computer software skills required.
* Possess a good understanding of basic accounting principles such as numbering flow, “Debits/Credits”, adjusting entries, and corrections.
* Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship’s Senior Officers and the corporate office.

data.raw_snippet:

 We’re looking for a talented leader to help open WHOO
data.jd_text:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers its members to perform at a higher level by providing a deep understanding of the interactions between their unique physiology and chosen behaviors.
   

  

 We’re looking for a talented leader to help open WHOOP Labs Doha, our first international product research facility. The Doha lab will partner with the WHOOP Labs Boston team to conduct mixed\-methods research to support physiology, user experience, and consumer studies. To serve the company’s diverse testing and validation needs, WHOOP Labs completes tens of thousands of data collections a year and creates best in class experience for our participants. WHOOP Labs Doha will set the bar for product innovation research in the GCC, setting strategy for participant experience and contributing to advancing WHOOP technology.
   

  

 We’re looking for someone with a proven track record collaborating internationally and leading a cross\-functional team, who is excited to work with our members and isn’t afraid to roll up their sleeves and get sweaty. This position is in\-person in Doha, Qatar with potential travel to Boston, MA 1\-2 times per year.
   

  

**This role is based in the Doha, Qatar. We will only consider candidates who currently live in Doha, Qatar.**
**Responsibilities**
* Own the development and execution of the WHOOP Labs Doha opening strategy, including team hiring, participant compensation structure, and setting operating hours
* Champion research integrity, including ensuring that data collection tools and team practices align with local regulations for ethical human subjects research
* Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of program initiatives and track progress towards goals
* Ensure clear communication between the Boston and Doha labs, developing ways of working that support multi\-facility research execution
* Represent Doha culture and unique participant experience factors in broader strategic conversations with the rest of the WHOOP human subjects research team
* Build the WHOOP Labs Doha brand and represent WHOOP in the GCC region
* Reports to the Director of Human Subjects Research


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in a field related to human subjects research such as psychology, neuroscience, exercise physiology, or consumer science
* 5\+ years of full\-time professional experience in a related area
* 2\+ years of success leading a diversely skilled team
* Experience working on a distributed international team preferred
* Deep knowledge of local culture and ability to thoughtfully communicate localization considerations for research at WHOOP Labs Doha
* Understanding of best practices regarding human subjects research, including how to obtain IRB approval for new research projects; research ethics, data privacy, and consent
* Track record of successful project management, including resource allocation, timeline management, and risk mitigation
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills, ability to plan ahead while still being flexible and able to work around challenges
* Strong networking and collaboration skills, with experience in building partnerships and engaging with external stakeholders
* Ability to present findings to stakeholders and effectively communicate with company leaders
* Excitement to work in a high\-energy, fast\-paced startup environment
* Understanding of branding and marketing as it applies to research in industry spaces
* Fluency in verbal and written English, WHOOP’s working language


**This role is based in the Doha, Qatar. We will only consider candidates who currently live in Doha, Qatar.**
 Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.
   

  

 WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E\-verify to determine employment eligibility. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

**About Agoda**
 At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
   

  

 Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
   

  

 No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
   

  

**Who we are:**
 Agoda is Asia’s leading and fastest growing online hotel reservation website. Maintaining this position requires an incredible amount of data, a superior IT infrastructure, and world class talent to bring it all together. Information Technology is Agoda’s core competency, and an IT career with us provides excellent growth opportunities in an exciting, multicultural environment with 74 nationalities.
   

  

 Agoda’s IT department is a fast\-paced environment where innovation and creative thinking matter; where passion for new technology applied in creative ways drives us to constantly improve the customer experience. We strive to create products and services that make a difference, and work hard to ensure continuous, consistent progress and we never forget to have fun while doing it.
   

  

**What we need:**
 Agoda is currently seeking a talented and experienced IT Service Delivery Manager to join our IT Support Department. The ideal candidate will have a strong track record of leading end\-to\-end IT service delivery in Windows and macOS environments, with a focus on improving user experience, meeting SLAs, reducing time to resolution, and driving measurable service improvements (e.g., laptop performance, ticket response times) while delivering cost\-effective outcomes within agreed KPIs.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Own and continuously improve IT support service delivery, ensuring consistent performance against SLAs/OLAs and agreed KPIs.
* Lead operational governance for service performance (e.g., daily/weekly reviews), producing clear reporting on ticket volumes, response/resolution times, CSAT, and recurring issues.
* Manage Incident, Problem, and Change processes to restore service quickly, reduce repeat incidents through root\-cause analysis, and minimize business disruption from changes.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams (IT Support, Infrastructure, Security, Engineering, and business stakeholders) to prioritize demand, remove blockers, and deliver service enhancements.
* Oversee key suppliers and partners, including performance management, escalation handling, service reviews, and cost control to ensure value for money.
* Drive continual service improvement initiatives (process, tooling, automation, and knowledge management) to improve productivity, reduce MTTR, and enhance end\-user experience.
* Maintain service documentation, including service catalog entries, runbooks, SOPs, and operational procedures.


**Requirements:**
* Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 5\+ years of experience in IT Service Delivery, IT Operations, or IT Support leadership roles.
* Strong understanding of ITIL/ITSM practices (Incident, Problem, Change, Request Fulfilment, Knowledge, and Service Level Management).
* Experience managing and reporting on SLAs/KPIs and driving continual service improvement.
* Familiarity with corporate IT services including Microsoft 365, Entra, Active Directory and GSuite. Along with Windows and macOS endpoint management.
* Hands\-on experience with ITSM/ticketing tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Freshservice) and operational reporting.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and escalation skills across technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Strong organizational, time\-management, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Experience managing vendors and budgets to deliver cost\-effective services.

data.jd_text:
Lead the successful delivery of advanced venue technology solutions across stadiums, sports venues, and large\-scale international sporting events. The role is responsible for managing end\-to\-end technology project delivery, ensuring seamless integration of ICT, AV, and ELV systems while enhancing operational readiness and event\-day experience for stakeholders, organizers, and spectators.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Lead the overall delivery lifecycle of Venue Technology projects from concept initiation through planning, procurement, implementation, testing, commissioning, and operational handover.
* Manage RFP preparation, tendering activities, vendor evaluations, contract coordination, and post\-award project execution activities.
* Develop and maintain project documentation, governance artefacts, technical specifications, implementation plans, and reporting frameworks for all Venue Technology initiatives.
* Oversee project execution in coordination with vendors, consultants, contractors, and internal project management teams.
* Develop integrated project plans aligned with operational, engineering, and event delivery requirements across stadiums, venues, clubs, and mega\-event environments.
* Define and document functional and technical requirements for venue technology systems and infrastructure.
* Support Venue Technology Operations teams and event organizers in defining project scope, operational expectations, and technical delivery requirements.
* Monitor project performance, risks, issues, timelines, budgets, and quality standards to ensure successful delivery outcomes.
* Ensure compliance with applicable industry standards, regulatory requirements, cybersecurity standards, and venue operational guidelines.
* Lead contract performance management activities to ensure vendor compliance, service quality, and client satisfaction throughout project execution and delivery phases.
* Coordinate testing, commissioning, integration validation, operational readiness, and transition\-to\-operations activities.



  





**Delivery Resource Planning \& Governance** 




  




* Manage and report on the progress of all Venue Technology projects and delivery programs.
* Provide regular executive\-level updates, dashboards, and status reports to senior leadership and stakeholders.

data.jd_text:
**Head Of Physical Education (whole School \- Male)**
**Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK), Qatar**
**Job Overview**
**Head of Physical Education (Whole School \- Male)**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor is looking to appoint an outstanding Head of Physical Education (Whole School \- Male) to join a well\-established, supportive team in a highly successful and expanding school.
   

  

**The closing date for applications 31st May 2026\.**
**The start date for this role is 1st August 2026\.**
**About You**
 You are an outstanding team leader with the track record for developing a vision for excellence and continual improvement. You excel in leading and managing people by creating a culture where colleagues are both supported and challenged to deliver the best possible learning experience for students. You can develop a highly motivated team by nurturing positive working relationships built on respect, trust, support, and recognition. You lead improvement through rigorous self\-evaluation of department performance and use quality assurance feedback to identify improvement priorities moving forward. You demonstrate excellent management skills such as resource management, curriculum planning, data analysis, performance tracking, task delegation, organisation of meetings and creating teacher timetables.
   

  

 You lead a learning culture where students are supported, challenged, and inspired to be the best they can be \- students in classes across the department will believe there are no limits to what can be achieved. Your excellent motivation and communication skills enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within all lessons across the department.
   

  

 Receptive to feedback and ready to embrace change, you will be keen to share best practice with colleagues and peers. As a strong ambassador for the school, you will be able to develop new ways to engage students and parents across both our school (NAISAK), and the wider Nord Anglia Education communities. Your strong motivation and communication skills will also enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within the classroom.
   

  

 You will have the following:
   

  

  

* university degree in your specialist subject
* teaching qualification
* substantial Secondary level teaching experience, and knowledge of the Physical Education National curriculum, and IGCSE and A Level curriculums


 You will also be able to meet visa\-related restrictions for Qatar, including possession of a Bachelor's degree and a teaching qualification from a face\-to\-face (non\-online) course.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join our dynamic international education environment, where you will lead the delivery a fit\-for\-purpose curriculum, built on the UK National Curriculum and preparing students for external examinations at IGSCE/AS\-A levels. You will lead the development of a culture in which students are challenged to be ambitious learners and teachers are required to be innovative to enhance the student experience and outcomes. You will understand the diverse international language environment within our school community to manage effective curriculum programmes to not only teach Physical Education subject content but also continue to support English language development for students across all areas of the school curriculum. Developing a high\-quality extra\-curricular programme for sport and health is a key priority, with a dual\-focus on development\-for\-all and competition.
   

  

 Your educational philosophy will equip you to meet the needs of all learners and be able to teach students with a range of prior achievement, knowledge, and skills. Your expertise and planning adaptability will allow you to map out pathways for all students to progress in your subject, creating opportunities for all learners to achieve success based on individualised targets. You will contribute to good practice by demonstrating a collegiate approach to departmental development and sharing strategies with colleagues.
   

  

 As Head of Physical Education, you will be responsible for leading the planning, delivery and evaluation of the curriculum, teaching and learning, assessment, reporting, student behaviour, and professional development of teachers across the Physical Education department.
   

  

 Please refer to the job description of the role for the following information:
   

  

  

* Job purpose
* Reporting to
* Key relationships
* Key results areas
* Performance measurement


**About Our School**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK) is a highly successful, growing school with a committed and inspirational team of teaching professionals at its heart. Our close\-knit, supportive team is proud to be at the centre of the local community, educating over 1350 young people aged 3\-18\. Secondary is 4\-form entry at Key Stage 3, and 3\-form entry in KS4 upwards, with approximately 530 students aged 11\-18\.
   

  

 Our school resides in the town of Al Khor, 35 minutes north of Doha (the capital of Qatar). We educate both local and expat students through a bespoke Secondary curriculum which draws on both the Physical Education National curriculum and the Qatar Ministry of Education curriculum.
   

  

 The school is focused on supporting students towards enhanced Physical Education language acquisition, excellent academic outcomes and outstanding learning experiences through STEAM, Performing Arts, extra\-curricular activities, residential trips, and international awards for wider achievement.
   

  

 The school prides itself on fostering student wellbeing, personalisation of learning and a strong sense of multiculturalism and global citizenship. We also have strong through\-school links and ensure consistent progression from Primary to Secondary to offer all our students a rewarding learning journey. The Primary school buildings have recently undergone further refurbishment following the opening of a brand\-new Secondary building in August 2019\. Our students also now benefit from a new 25m outdoor pool.
   

  

 To learn more about NAISAK, please visit
   

  

 https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/nais\-al\-khor
   

  

**About Nord Anglia Education**
 Each Nord Anglia Education school is unique in character and designed to meet the needs of its community. We are united by our philosophy, to be ambitious for our students, our people, and our family of schools. We believe that being part of our family of schools gives them a special advantage. Working together, we can achieve more than we can individually. Our schools have access to a wide range of resources and support to enhance their success. We also create unique opportunities to benefit our students and people, such as the Global Campus, Nord Anglia University, and our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King's College London.
   

  

 When you join a Nord Anglia Education school, you join a global community of more than 16,000 people working together to support our students' success. We offer you unsurpassed opportunities to innovate and develop best practice across our family, to access extensive professional development, and to gain exceptional experience and career development in our schools. At Nord Anglia, you will have opportunities to progress more, learn more, and collaborate more.
   

  

 Our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King's College London, offer our teachers unrivalled access to leading experts in their fields. We also offer selected candidates from our staff worldwide an opportunity to earn their Executive Master's in International Education in an exclusive collaboration with King's College London.
   

  

 Alongside great training and a competitive package, you'll enjoy the chance to live and work in one of the world's most vibrant countries.
   

  

 As a Nord Anglia Education teacher, you enjoy the following benefits:
   

  

  

* A fast\-paced, global experience so that you can progress on a global scale
* An enabling environment founded on creativity, challenge and collaboration
* A culture that is fair and consultative
* Unique opportunities to grow professionally and develop your career
* Opportunities to apply for further leadership positions


**SELECTION PROCESS**
 Applicants should submit a CV, letter of application, and the details of two professional referees, one of which should be your current Principal/Head Teacher. Interviews will be conducted at the school or via Microsoft Teams.
   

  

 Please visit us online at www.nordangliaeducation.jobs
   

  

 Please note, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
   

  

**We reserve the rights to close this position early if we find the ideal candidate.**
**SAFEGUARDING**
 At Nord Anglia Education we are committed to providing a world class, safe, happy environment in which children and young people can thrive and learn. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all our pupils irrespective of race, ability, religion, gender, or culture.
   

  

 All post holders having regular unsupervised contact with children are subject to appropriate national and international vetting procedures including satisfactory criminal record checks from both your country of residence/birth and any country of residence within the last 10 years.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunities employer, and we welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons.

data.jd_text:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 As a Service Project Manager at Siemens Energy, you will be at the forefront of executing service orders for the compression fleet, driving meaningful projects that enhance operational excellence and customer satisfaction. Your role will involve strategic planning and coordination, ensuring that projects are delivered within scope, time, quality, and budget, thereby contributing significantly to Siemens Energy’s mission of sustainable energy solutions. You will work in a dynamic team environment that values collaboration, innovation, and proactive communication, fostering a culture of growth and excellence.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Execute compression service orders, including parts, repairs, field service, and complete outage projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
* Manage customer relationships during order execution, acting as their advocate within the organization and enhancing communication across service offerings.
* Organize and lead teams, define responsibilities, develop schedules, and allocate resources to address specific project challenges effectively.
* Extend service order management to the Middle Eastern region as needed, ensuring seamless execution and delivery.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to achieve revenue, EBIT, on\-time delivery, and project delivery targets, while driving client satisfaction and supporting cash collection.
* Collaborate with finance for accurate forecasting and coordinate with global teams to align service order execution with global standards.


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, project management, or a related field, with 4\-6 years of relevant experience in project management, preferably in the Oil \& Gas industry or with rotating equipment.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and leadership skills, with the ability to develop and implement strategic plans effectively.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and experience with project management and order management tools and concepts.
* Self\-driven and adaptable, with a positive attitude and the ability to solve challenges collaboratively.
* Familiarity with CRM (Salesforce) and ERP software (e.g., SAP) is highly desirable, enhancing operational efficiency.
* Excellent communication, networking, and relationship\-building skills, with strong leadership abilities to influence stakeholders and drive project success.


**About The Team**
 Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
* Opportunities to work with a global team
* Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects
* Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens\-Energy platform


 https://jobs.siemens\-energy.com/jobs
   

  

 The job posting will remain open for applications for 14 days from the posting date.

data.jd_text:
**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Directs, coaches, supports, supervises, and evaluates (with the Sous Chef) all direct reports.
* Must have excellent food knowledge and a full understanding of culinary terms.
* Must be able to read, understand, follow, and prepare company recipes by maintaining the quality and consistency in taste according to the instructions provided by the corporate office.
* Must be proficient in completing tasks, work efficiently and productively.
* Must be able to work in any section of a kitchen.
* Coordinate and supervise all team members assigned to their section, assign and delegate tasks accordingly.
* Undertake recipe reviews daily. Maintain recipe folders in immaculate condition.
* Responsible for follow\-through on any request within the area of responsibility received from the direct supervisor or manager on duty; this may include show plates, food samples and random food tastings.
* Control production levels and recommend ideas for improvements and better cost controlling.
* Prepare daily electronic food requisitions needed for his section production and countercheck deliveries for its accuracy; Report any discrepancies to his immediate supervisor.
* Must be able to oversee any main section (Sauce, Entremetier, Fish, Roast, Outlet CDP, Tournant and Cold Kitchen) and its entire food production.
* Maintain and ensure that Public Health are followed according to company standards and expectation (referring to US, Anvisa, Shipsan, Canadian, Australian etc.) and always followed within their section.
* Ensures that the HACCP program is carried out correctly.
* Maintains their assigned area in preparation for announced or unannounced United States Public Health type inspection either done by the Food \& Beverage Director or the actual inspectors.
* Reports for duty at assigned times, follows their supervisor’s instructions, and ensures that personal appearance, uniform, and personal hygiene are in accordance with the company’s rules and regulations.



  





**Qualifications and Skills**



* A minimum of 8 years in an upscale hotel, resort, cruise ship or convention banqueting service and at least 2 years as Chef de Partie (shipboard experience preferred).
* A culinary school degree is required.
* Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
* Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
* Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
* Knowledge of the principles and processes for providing personalized services including needs assessment techniques, quality service standards, alternative delivery systems, and guest satisfaction evaluation techniques.
* Strong planning, coaching, organizing, staffing, controlling, and evaluating skills.
* Intermediate computer software skills required.
* Possess a good understanding of basic accounting principles such as numbering flow, “Debits/Credits”, adjusting entries, and corrections.
* Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship’s Senior Officers and the corporate office.

 The Project Manager is responsible for delivering and leading the assigned project. This includes review of handover documentation from Tender Team, Project Kick\-off, planning, executing, controlling, monitoring and closing out the project, while managing risks, opportunities, commercial management, timelines, resources and the entire scope of the project. * Direct line of report Regional Projects Director
* Critique tender documentation / Pre\-Construction project handover documentation, identify project risks and opportunities with Project Leads
* Manages the expectations of project leadership and stakeholders throughout the project.
* Ensures all departments are complying with all standard JEG SOP’s
* Responsible for managing the execution of all project milestones/deliverables. Establish and monitor program and project controls KPI's.
* Acts as a primary day to day liaison to the client project leadership teams and project execution partners.
* Identifies and resolve disputes quickly and reasonably with Project Stakeholders.
* Develops and maintains a comprehensive project plan, in keeping with the size and complexity as mutually agreed upon by the JEG organization SOP and the Project Director.

Ensure regular audits are carried out for EHS compliance and any remedial actions are implemented in coordination with the HSE Manager.

**Experience \& Qualifications**

* Minimum 10 years work experience on construction projects / Minimum 3 years as a Project Manager
* Qualifications commensurate with position:
* Role applicable degree from a reputed university / Trade Qualifications NVQ, etc.
* Experience in Data Centre Projects.
* Competent in the use of PC applications (Microsoft Office suit or equivalent)
* Civil/ CSA experience

data.jd_text:
We are hiring a Senior Executive Director to lead private equity investments from Bahrain, with responsibility for sourcing, executing and managing deals across the GCC and select international markets. This role is central to the platform’s growth and will work closely with senior leadership and the broader alternatives franchise.
 



  





**What you’ll do** 




  




* Lead origination, thesis development and pipeline management across target sectors and geographies.
* Run end‑to‑end execution on transactions: financial modelling, valuation, due diligence, structuring and SPA negotiations.
* Prepare investment‑committee‑standard materials and present, defend and refine investment cases at committee.
* Take active post‑close ownership through board roles, performance monitoring, value creation oversight and exit execution.
* Support fundraising initiatives, LP co‑invest processes and coaching/development of junior investment professionals.



  





**What you bring** 




  




* 12–18 years’ experience, primarily in direct private equity investing, with formative training in investment banking (M\&A, leveraged finance) or transactions advisory.
* A strong deal sheet demonstrating independently sourced and led transactions, ideally including co‑invest and co‑sponsor deals.
* Deep GCC/MENA market knowledge and established relationships with regional advisors, banks and asset owners.
* Expert‑level financial modelling and LBO skills, with investment‑committee‑ready analytical and presentation standards.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics or a related discipline; CFA and/or MBA from a top‑tier institution preferred.



  





**Why this platform** 




  




* Join a Bahrain‑headquartered financial group with a growing alternatives and private equity platform, investing across the MENA region and key international markets.
* Operate from a modern waterfront financial district designed to host leading investment firms and provide direct access to regional capital flows.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose:** 




 To drive the delivery of a risk\-based Technology Audit portfolio, providing strategic assurance and insights that strengthen IT governance, controls, and business performance. The role leads complex technology audit engagements standalone or integrated with business audits, develops high\-performing teams, fosters collaboration, and ensures the Internal Audit function adds measurable value to organizational objectives.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities:** 




  





**Technology Audit and Advisory Delivery** 




  




* Supports with the technology component of a risk\-based IA plan by coordinating and managing the delivery of the IT risk assessment and annual planning activities. This involves proposing audit engagements for inclusion in IA plans, including the scope, timing, and required resources.
* Acts as the Engagement Manager\* for multiple or large integrated audit engagements concerning technology audit areas within the IA Department. Responsible for the day\-to\-day project management of the engagements across planning, fieldwork and reporting, ensuring delivery of high\-quality assurance and advice, on time and within allocated budget.
* Establishes and maintains regular coordination between the IA Director (or Executive Director), management and the engagement team on the
* progress of engagements, ensuring corrective actions are taken to address any identified issues impacting the engagement plan.
* Regularly monitors and reports on the progress of management action plans, facilitating the effective and timely implementation of management action plans. This involves guiding action owners (where necessary), challenging revised due dates, escalating overdue actions and managing the verification of closed actions.
* Supports and coach engagement teams throughout the engagement lifecycle, to facilitate the correct application of the IA methodology, and enhances the teams’ functional and leadership competencies.
* Supports the VP, Internal, IA Director (or Executive Director) with the delivery of their role, as delegated.
* Ensure delivery of high\-impact, risk\-based audits that enhance control effectiveness and strengthen control environment and organizational governance.



  





**IT Governance Framework, ERP and Data Analytics** 



* Evaluate the design and effectiveness of IT governance frameworks (e.g., COBIT, ISO 27001, ITIL etc.), ensuring alignment with organizational policies, regulatory expectations, and risk‑management objectives.
* Assess ERP environments (SAP S/4 Hana etc.) for configuration adequacy, access controls, change‑management practices, and process integrity across key business cycles.
* Perform technology risk assessments to identify control gaps, security vulnerabilities, and compliance issues within core IT processes and enterprise applications.
* Leverage data analytics tools (e.g., SQL, Power BI, Python) to perform automated testing, trend analysis, anomaly detection, and continuous\-monitoring routines.
* Develop sound audit findings and recommendations that strengthen IT controls, improve system performance, and enhance data reliability, while collaborating with stakeholders across IT, finance, and operations.



  





**Leadership** 



* Plans, manages, and reviews team performance to monitor achievement of key performance indicators.
* Provides timely feedback, coaching, and development to strengthen team capabilities.
* Proposes and implements initiatives aligned with the IA strategic direction.
* Leads or supports IA strategic initiatives and advocates for positive change in work practices.
* Build a high\-performing, future\-ready IA team aligned with strategic business goals.



  





**Quality \& Operations** 



* Ensures QAIP feedback is addressed effectively to enhance engagement quality and team capability.
* Promotes adherence to quality standards across all IA activities.
* Supports continuous improvement by identifying and implementing process enhancements and best practices.
* Drive culture of continuous improvement and excellence in audit execution.

data.jd_text:
Head of Engineering: Options
   

  

**About Keyrock**
 Since our beginnings in 2017, we've grown to be a leading change\-maker in the digital asset space, renowned for our partnerships and innovation.
   

  

 Today, we rock with over 200 team members around the world. Our diverse team hails from 42 nationalities, with backgrounds ranging from DeFi natives to PhDs. Predominantly remote, we have hubs in London, Madrid, Brussels, Singapore , New York and Paris, and host regular online and offline hangouts to keep the crew tight.
   

  

 We are trading on more than 80 exchanges, and working with a wide array of asset issuers. As a well\-established market maker, our distinctive expertise led us to expand rapidly. Today, our services span market making, options trading, high\-frequency trading, OTC, and DeFi trading desks as well as asset and wealth management. Keyrock is looking to expand and establish itself as a full\-service capital markets and asset \& wealth management financial institution through both organic innovation and inorganic growth.
   

  

 But we’re more than a service provider. We’re an initiator. We have been pioneers in adopting the Rust Development language for our algorithmic trading systems, and champions of its use in the industry. We upgrade Web3 ecosystems by injecting liquidity into promising DeFi, RWA, and NFT protocols. And we push the industry's progress with our research and governance initiatives.
   

  

 At Keyrock, we're not just envisioning the future of digital assets. We're actively building it.
   

  

**Mission statement**
 We are looking for a
 **Head of Engineering / Engineering Lead** 
 with strong experience in
 **systematic options trading** 
 to lead our Options Engineering team.
   

  

 In this role, you will be responsible for leading the Options Engineering team, driving continuous improvement across the trading infrastructure, and supporting the evolution of our systematic options trading platform. This includes areas such as automated quoting, execution, risk controls, pricing workflows, and production reliability.
   

  

 We are primarily looking for candidates based in
 **European time zones** 
 or the
 **US East Coast time zone** 
 .
   

  

**We are looking for someone who can:**
* Lead and grow an Options Engineering team of around 7 engineers
* Bring hands\-on experience in systematic options trading, ideally including options market\-making, automated quoting, execution, and risk management
* Own and evolve an existing Rust\-native systematic options trading platform
* Provide strong technical direction across trading infrastructure, system design, performance, reliability, and risk controls
* Work pragmatically through complex engineering and trading\-system challenges
* Partner closely with trading, quant, product, risk, and infrastructure stakeholders
* Balance technical leadership with people leadership, delivery ownership, and operational discipline


**Required Experience**
* 7\+ years of experience in systematic trading, options market\-making or low\-latency trading systems
* Strong hands\-on experience with Rust, C\+\+, or C
* Willingness to become deeply proficient in Rust, if not already
* Strong understanding of algorithmic options trading, including automated quoting, execution, pricing, risk controls, and market data workflows
* Experience building or maintaining low\-latency trading systems, ideally within options or derivatives markets
* Experience working with SQL databases in production environments, with PostgreSQL preferred
* Familiarity with functional testing, component testing, and production\-grade validation practices
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, service boundaries, and production reliability
* Strong knowledge of gRPC and experience working with Node.js\-based services is preferred
* Previous experience with crypto exchange connectivity and/or FPGA technologies is strongly preferred


**Leadership \& Working Style**
* Strong team player with the ability to lead, mentor, and guide engineers
* Pragmatic approach to problem\-solving, system design, and implementation
* Able to balance latency, reliability, safety, complexity, and delivery speed
* Comfortable making technical decisions under uncertainty
* Demonstrates outside\-the\-box thinking while staying grounded in practical delivery
* Communicates clearly and effectively, especially in unfamiliar or ambiguous contexts where clarity is critical
* Able to work closely with traders, quants, risk, product, and infrastructure stakeholders
* Strong ownership mindset, especially for production trading systems


**Our recruitment philosophy**
 We value self\-awareness and powerful communication skills in our recruitment process. We seek fiercely passionate people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, acts with ownership and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.
   

  

**Our offer**
* A competitive salary package
* Autonomy in your time management thanks to flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely
* The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence


 As an employer we are committed to building a positive and collaborative work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, and hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.
   

  

 Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
* Maintenance Execution
* Receive instructions from the Maintenance Unit Head/Manager for assigned maintenance tasks and projects.
* Carry out specific maintenance tasks related to machine repairs, new machine commissioning, and validation activities.
* Assist the maintenance team in troubleshooting breakdowns and performing preventive maintenance (PM) as required.
* Prepare designs for specific machine upgrades (electrical or mechanical) and submit them for management review and approval.
* Follow up on project execution after design approval.
* Clean and organize the working area upon task completion.
* Document task details, including timing, completion status, and any new observations/findings.
* Submit Repair Request Forms (RRF) for any pending tasks or additional issues found.
* Obtain feedback from production teams to ensure full resolution and satisfaction.
* Coordination \& Spare Parts Management
* Coordinate with the Maintenance Unit Head/Manager to ensure proper resource allocation for assigned projects.
* Coordinate with the Store regarding delivery of critical spare parts and escalate any delays.
* Prepare and submit Spare Parts Requisition Forms as needed.
* Data Analysis \& Improvement
* Analyze maintenance data, including repetitive breakdowns, delays in PM, and spare part consumption.
* Propose action plans and improvements based on analysis findings.
* Calibration \& External Services
* Execute in\-house calibration tasks as per instructions and defined Work Instructions (WI).
* Coordinate outsourced calibration activities with the Local Purchasing Unit (LPC).
* Ensure timely availability of external calibration agencies, oversee tasks, and follow up on calibration certificates.
* Update the Calibration Master File upon completion.
* Safety \& 5S Compliance
* Follow all NAPCO\-IFP safety procedures and attend all required safety meetings.
* Enforce company health and safety policies among the team and monitor for compliance.
* Carry out risk assessments and ensure emergency response protocols are understood by all personnel.
* Immediately report and act upon unsafe acts, conditions, or near\-misses.
* Participate in cross\-auditing and ensure adherence to the plant’s hazard control standards.
* Conduct daily safety talks in assigned work areas.
* Perform assigned 5S duties as per the 5S plan to maintain an efficient and safe work environment.
* Safety Responsibilities
* Enforce full compliance with health and safety procedures across the maintenance area.
* Understand and ensure all subordinates are trained on safe work practices.
* Identify unsafe conditions or behaviors and take immediate corrective action.
* Lock out any unsafe equipment until it is repaired and deemed safe.
* Actively participate in safety audits, emergency drills, and 5S implementation.
* Promote safety awareness among team members.
* Job Dynamics \& Interfaces


**Internal Interfaces**
* Maintenance Team
* Production Team
* Store \& Spare Parts Team
* Health \& Safety Department


**External Interfaces**
* Local Purchasing Unit (LPC)
* External Calibration Agencies
* Required Qualifications


**Education \& Experience**
* University degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering (preferred).
* Strong reading, writing, and arithmetic skills.
* At least 2–4 years of experience in industrial maintenance or plant engineering roles.


**Competencies**
* Strong knowledge of maintenance techniques (mechanical and electrical).
* Ability to read machine manuals, technical diagrams, and work instructions.
* Familiarity with spare parts management and calibration procedures.
* Analytical skills for root cause analysis and continuous improvement.
* Proficiency in documenting maintenance activities and reporting.
* Special Working Conditions
* Must be in good physical condition and able to work under pressure.
* Willingness to work alternating shifts.
* Must adhere to all local labor laws and NAPCO\-IFP safety policies.

data.jd_text:
**Objective:**
 RCSI Bahrain is seeking to appoint a dynamic and clinically focused Lecturer / Senior Lecturer in Clinical Microbiology to support the delivery of undergraduate and postgraduate medical education within the School of Medicine.
   

  

 Given the clinically integrated nature of the curriculum, the University is specifically seeking a medically qualified clinician with expertise in Infectious Diseases and/or Clinical (Medical) Microbiology. The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering clinically relevant microbiology teaching aligned to modern medical practice, patient safety, antimicrobial stewardship, infection prevention, and clinical decision\-making.
   

  

 The appointee will contribute to teaching, assessment, curriculum development, academic advising, and scholarly activity, while supporting the continued integration of microbiology across systems\-based and case\-based learning. The appointee will collaborate closely with the Department of Clinical Microbiology in RCSI Dublin, including participation in teaching and assessment meetings to ensure a coordinated and standardised approach to teaching and assessment across both campuses.
   

  

 Appointment may be made at Lecturer or Senior Lecturer level depending on qualifications, experience, academic profile, and leadership contribution.
   

  

**Reporting To:** 
 Head of Department of Medicine or Nominee
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Teaching:**
 • Deliver high\-quality teaching in microbiology, infectious diseases, infection prevention, and antimicrobial stewardship across undergraduate programmes.
   

 • Contribute to integrated and clinically contextualised teaching within systems\-based and case\-based curricula.
   

 • Facilitate small\-group teaching, tutorials, laboratory interpretation sessions, clinical correlation sessions, and team\-based learning activities.
   

 • Support the development and delivery of clinically relevant microbiology practical and simulation activities.
   

 • Contribute to online and blended learning initiatives using the University’s digital learning platforms.
   

 • Participate in student assessment activities including question writing, OSCEs, practical examinations, standard setting, and moderation processes.
   

 • Participate in teaching and assessment meeting with the Dept of Clinical Microbiology, RCSI, Dublin
   

 • Provide academic mentorship and pastoral support to students.
   

 • Work collaboratively with clinical and basic science colleagues to ensure relevance and consistency of teaching delivery.
   

 • Contribute to curriculum planning, vertical integration, sequencing, and alignment of microbiology and infectious diseases teaching across the undergraduate programme.
   

 • Work collaboratively across disciplines including medicine, pathology, pharmacology, immunology, paediatrics, and public health to support integrated curriculum delivery.
   

 • Support clinically relevant microbiology practical teaching, simulation activities aligned to clinical practice.
   

  

**Research and Scholarship**
 • Contribute to scholarly activity, educational innovation, research, and/or clinical academic initiatives relevant to microbiology or infectious diseases.
   

 • Support student research, audits, quality improvement initiatives, and scholarly dissemination.
   

 • Develop collaborative links with clinical partners and healthcare institutions within Bahrain and wider region.
   

  

**Student Mentoring:**
 • Provide pastoral care, mentorship, and support in developing research projects to students
   

 • Participate in the Personal Tutor Program to support student well\-being and academic development.
   

  

**General:**
 • Participate in School and University committees, working groups, and academic governance activities.
   

 • Support quality assurance, accreditation, and regulatory activities as required.
   

 • Contribute to outreach, student recruitment, and community engagement initiatives.
   

 • Undertake additional duties appropriate to the grade of appointment.
   

 • Attend administrative and academic meetings relevant to clinical teaching.
   

 • Provide regular feedback to the Head of Department on program content and curriculum development and assist in implementing improvements where appropriate
   

 • Ensure that all RCSI Bahrain policies and procedures are adhered to
   

 • Participate in faculty development and medical education training activities as required.
   

 • Familiarises oneself with the RCSI Bahrain Virtual Learning Environment (VLE)
   

  

  

 Requirements
   

  

**Personal Specifications:** 
  

  

 • Medical degree recognised for clinical practice.
   

 • Specialist qualification and/or board certification and/or FRCPath or equivalent in:
   

  

 o Infectious Diseases, and/or
   

 o Medical Microbiology, and/or
   

 o Clinical Microbiology.
   

  

 • Eligibility for professional registration/licensure in the Kingdom of Bahrain.
   

 • Experience delivering clinical microbiology / infectious diseases teaching.
   

 • Experience in assessment design, moderation, and standard setting.
   

 • Experience with case\-based or blended learning approaches.
   

 • Postgraduate qualification in medical education or ongoing faculty development activity is desirable.
   

 • Ability to deliver high\-quality teaching and educational activities within required timelines.
   

 • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
   

 • Ability to demonstrate initiative
   

 • Strong organisational and administrative skills

Incumbent will be responsible for management of all classes of risks for Mashreq Bahr
data.jd_text:
Incumbent is expected to lead the global coordination of ESG \& Climate risk related governance, policy universe, regulatory reporting, gap analysis \& remediation against various home and host country regulations. Incumbent will be responsible for management of all classes of risks for Mashreq Bahrain in coordination with HO Risk (retail and wholesale branch). Incumbent is expected to meet all regulatory and management\-related expectations on risk management in coordination with Central Functions in Head Office.
 



  





**Global Head of ESG Risks** 



* Development, maintenance and implementation of group wide ESG \& climate risk related policy universe. e.g. Climate Risk Policy, ESG Risk policy, Inputs to other risk management policy universe for embedding ESG risk into policy universe in coordination with other relevant stakeholders.
* Ensuring inputs required from Risk management for all disclosures related to, Net zero, Transition planning etc. are fulfilled and coordinated.
* Focal point of coordination for ESG Risks related matters across Mashreq Group supporting country risk managers for coordination and management of ESG risks across Mashreq’s Presence countries overseas including escalation, alignment, and best‑practice sharing.
* Establishing ESG risks related roles and responsibilities across the organization via appropriate governance of ESG risk at the relevant management committees, forums, workshops, conferences and other events in areas of ESG \& climate risk. e.g. Group Risk committee, BRCESGC, IBG ESG Committee, ESG Committee, Sustainability Executive committee etc.
* Conducting gap analysis, roadmaps and remediation plans for various ESG \& climate risk related regulatory guidelines and associated regulatory submissions e.g. CB UAE climate risk principles and regulation.
* Ownership of ESG risk measurement oversight and ensuring compliance with all internal policies and procedures
* Change management for ESG \& climate risk related initiatives and automation projects in coordination with ESG team, One Data \& Technology, External consultants and other stakeholders across three lines of defense while ensuring compliance with data governance standards and coordination with enterprise data teams and designated data champions.
* Supporting the development and enhancement of various regulatory reporting disclosures like GRI, ESG Reporting, ISSB, IFRS S1 and S2, Pillar 3 disclosures etc. with ESG \& climate related financial risks inputs across home and host countries regulations.
* Supporting the internal \& external capacity building initiatives via training and awareness around ESG \& climate risk



  





**Chief Risk Officer Bahrain** 



* Country Risk Manager Bahrain will be a regulatory function responsible for coordination \& management of governance of all risk classes for Mashreq Bahrain in coordination with HO Risk
* Act as credit risk management local coordinator for the outsourced element to head office credit management group
* The incumbent will act as a secretary of Bahrain Risk Committee and will be focal point of coordination for day\-to\-day coordination around management of all risk classes in coordination with HO Risk. Management of Bahrain Risk Committee, Charter/TOR, minutes of meeting.
* Implementation of International Risk Management framework for Mashreq Bahrain. Maintenance, reporting \& monitoring of Level 3 Country Risk Appetite for Bahrain
* Responsible for maintenance of Local risk management related policy \& process notes \& CORR and handling of regulatory requirements.
* Point person for supporting Business and support function coordination pertaining to Enterprise risk management and applicable regulatory frameworks. Supporting compliance with risk management related regulatory guidelines and BASEL requirements.
* Country Operational Risk oversight role including responsibilities guidance and support to local team, RCSA design, sample testing and monitoring implementation, bridging between ORM\- HO and Branch, escalation to HO ORM, trainings etc.
* Oversee Bahrain credit bureau related review, support and follow up for issue resolutions.
* Oversee Mashreq Bahrain risk indicators implementation and support audit readiness. Keep the Risk Committee/ Designated Committee(s) and Senior Management apprised of the assumptions used in and potential shortcomings of the Bank risk models and analysis.
* Ensure that:



 i. Risk reporting to the Risk Committee/ Designated Committee(s) is carefully designed to convey bank\-wide, individual portfolio and other risks in a concise and meaningful manner for designated areas in accordance with HO Risk guidelines/ policies. While reporting, must accurately communicate risk exposures and results of stress tests or scenario analyses and must provoke a robust discussion.
 



 ii. Material risk\-related ad\-hoc information that requires immediate decisions or reactions is promptly presented to Senior Management/ HO Risk and, as appropriate, the Risk Committee/ Designated Committee(s), the responsible officers and, where applicable, the Heads of Control Functions so that suitable measures and activities can be initiated at an early stage
 



**ESG Coordinator** 



* Focal point of coordination for ESG related matters for branches supporting central ESG team for associated regulatory submissions and disclosures for home and host countries.
* Training and awareness for first line of defense to ensure ESG and climate risk related data integration coordination with central function for branches including but not limited to Obligors, third parties, suppliers etc.
* Liaising on climate risk related initiatives for the branches with relevant central teams.
* Supporting central function in formulation of ESG including but not limited to climate risk related policy and procedural aspects for branches.
* Implementation support of ESG, sustainable finance and climate risk related solutions and systems for branches.
* Participation in overall ESG governance as applicable/ Responsible to cover relevant requirements in line CBB ESG Module (CBB Rulebook – Common Volume)
* Second Line of Defense responsibility for ESG risk and relevant ESG regulations across home and host countries, including alignment with Group frameworks



  





 Knowlege,Skills and Experience
 



  




* At least fifteen years of risk management experience, out of which minimum of five years should be in related areas
* Good knowledge of International and Bahrain Regulatory environment
* Expertise with ESG and Climate Risk frameworks
* Strong analytical skills and knowledge on Financial Risk Management
* Professional Risk management Qualification incl. Professional Certification would be a distinct advantage e.g. CFA / FRM/ IRM/ PRM/ SCR (Sustainability \& Climate Risk)
* Excellent computer skills (especially MS office, PPT \& Excel)



 Team player, self\-starter, innovative and highly motivated.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 Reporting to Head Technical Training, the position of Electrical Instructor is involved in the preparation of curriculum, training manuals, and materials as well as the delivery of technical training to the designated employees and other company staff.
   

  

**Key Result Areas (All Roles)**
* Conduct training needs analysis (TNA) and develop appropriate training programs including but not limited to externally accredited Diploma \& Certificated courses.
* Assist in developing unit technology specific Lesson Plans and supplemental instructional materials to deliver required knowledge, skills and attitude among the trainees.
* Deliver competency based technical training relevant to electrical systems for all units, infrastructure, equipment, systems and subsystems in the BMP refinery to prepare Electricians for greenfield start up, current plant operations and future positions of the BMP.
* Administer and deliver consistent Unit specific assessment, instruction and validation to electrical trainees, including but not limited to Electrical needs for:
* Scheduled and preventative maintenance
* Shutdowns and turnarounds
* Reliability and condition monitoring
* Hazardous area training, classification and certification
* High voltage switching and associated equipment training
* Refresher Training
* Ascertain that all training solutions are developed to enhance employee competency to maintain electrical requirements for all process plants during normal, emergency, and shut down situations, safely and effectively.
* Maintain accurate and detailed records of trainee's performance / progress and provide on the job support and guidance during and after the training event to ensure effective transfer of learning to the job.
* Follow Bapco’s strategic plan to provide effective provision of training closely aligned to the Competency Framework and OE processes.
* Evaluate and continuously update training courses to meet competency framework requirements and ensure that training solutions are in line with industry best practice.
* Acts independently regarding developing, scheduling and delivery with all associated in\-house communication.
* Establish and develop independent contacts with external suppliers as required and in developing training interventions for concerned departments to decide the most appropriate refresher and up skilling training requirements.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Experience**
* Minimum bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or equivalent.
* Minimum of 7 years' work experience of which a minimum of 3 years preferably in developing, conducting, and administering training programs for Oil Refineries or large Process Industries.
* Certified Assessor / Internal Verifier for Competency Based Assessment is preferred.
* Should be trained as a technical instructor with the ability to deliver general plant and process engineering learning modules.
* Work experience in Oil \& Gas Industry, preferably petroleum refining.
* Must have broad experience and familiarity gained from a wide range of refinery process units. Such as: Electrical substations, HV motors, VSD, electrical generators, UPS and associated equipment.
* In\-depth knowledge of learning theories and instructional design models. Lesson and curriculum planning skills.
* Ability to write effective instructional text, audio and video scripts.
* A good understanding of learning management systems is beneficial.


**About Us**
 Bapco Energies operates a portfolio spanning the entire energy value chain in the Kingdom of Bahrain. The portfolio includes wholly\-owned subsidiaries and specialized operating companies. Together, these companies drive Bapco Energies' mission to power the next generation.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Bapco Refining (with a legacy of being referred to as “The Company” in Arabic \- Ash Shariqa locally) is a trusted and enterprising organisation, which has never stood still since its inception. The first to discover oil in the Arabian peninsula in 1932, it started exporting crude in 1934, and installed the region’s first crude oil refinery in 1936\.
   

  

 Since then the Company has helped shape the modern Kingdom of Bahrain, not simply through the generation of wealth, but through its committed development of the people of Bahrain. The Company is known as the incubator of much of the leadership talent in Bahrain developed over many decades. Bapco Refining touches all aspects of life in the Kingdom.
   

  

 With a rich history of more than 85 years, the adventure continues with new ambitions and initiatives in the downstream sector as well as oil and gas field development. The most recent is the Company’s multi\-billion dollar expansion project which will significantly increase the Refinery’s capacity and employ the latest refining technology to meet future customer demands, latest fuels specifications and environmental compliance.
   

  

 Bapco Refining is engaged in the oil industry including refining and distribution of petroleum products, sales and exports of crude oil and refined products.
