data.jd_text:
**Job Description Summary**
 Vernova Purpose
   

  

 GE Vernova is accelerating the path to more reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy, while helping our customers power economies and deliver the electricity that is vital to health, safety, security, and improved quality of life. Are you excited at the opportunity to electrify and decarbonize the world?
   

  

 What impact you’ll make
   

  

 As a Operations Leader of the Project Center of Excellence, for Gas Power Heavy Duty Gas Turbines, you will be an active contributor to the delivery, cost, and productivity priorities of the business, while strengthening operational rigor, execution discipline, and cross\-functional alignment across a global project support organization. You will play a key role in enhancing portfolio visibility through robust reporting and performance management, resolving escalated operational issues, and leading continuous improvement initiatives that simplify processes, standardize ways of working, and improve overall organizational effectiveness.
   

  

**Job Description**
**What you’ll do**
* Lead the PCOE operating rhythm to drive execution, accountability, and alignment to business priorities.
* Partner closely with Fulfillment Functions and global stakeholders to ensure focus on key delivery, cost, and productivity objectives.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that simplify processes, improve efficiency, and strengthen execution consistency across the organization.
* Oversee portfolio\-level reporting and performance insights, ensuring clear visibility to execution status, risks, resource needs, and operational performance.
* Lead resolution of escalated operational issues, remove barriers to execution, and drive timely closure of actions.
* Apply Lean principles and operational excellence tools to improve productivity, reduce waste, and standardize ways of working.
* Partner across functions to identify and deploy best practices that improve project execution and organizational performance.
* Provide clear, concise communication to senior leadership on operational performance, key risks, improvement actions, and progress against priorities.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, problem solving, and ownership across a global, diverse team.


**What You’ll Bring (Basic Qualifications)**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field;
* Extensive experience in project and/or operations management within complex design\-to\-order industrial environments, ideally in large multinational companies.
* Strong capability to manage cross\-functional priorities and drive execution in fast\-paced environments.
* Proven experience in Lean, continuous improvement, or productivity initiatives, delivering measurable business impact.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with ability to influence across all organizational levels
* Fluent in English and willingness to travel


**What Will Make You Stand Out**
* Solid understanding of financial and accounting fundamentals.
* Ability to lead and develop global teams in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment


**Benefits Available To You**
 GE Vernova employees rise to the challenge of building a world that works. In order to meet this mission, we provide varied, competitive benefits to help support our workforce: Our Culture \| GE Vernova (gecareers.com)
   

  

* Our compensation \& benefits are designed to reward high performers and help you manage your personal and family needs. We offer a robust benefits package depending on your employment status and your national requirements.
* A healthy, balanced lifestyle can mean different things to different people. We've created programs that support the way you live and work today.
* GE Vernova invests to provide opportunities to grow your career by providing a path for continued on\-the\-job learning and development.


**Inclusion**
 At GE Vernova, we believe in the value of your unique identity, background and experiences. We are committed to fostering an
 **inclusive culture** 
 , where everyone feels empowered to do their best work because they feel accepted, respected and that they belong. Click here to learn more: https://jobs.gecareers.com/vernova/global/en/i\-d\-e
   

  

**About GE Vernova Gas Power**
 GE Vernova’s Gas Power business engineers advanced, efficient natural gas\-powered technologies and services, along with decarbonization solutions that aim to help electrify a lower carbon future. It is a global leader in gas turbines and power plant technologies and services with the industry’s largest installed base.
   

  

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 No
   

  

* This is a remote position


 Application Deadline: May 17, 2026

data.jd_text:
Beyon Connect
 



**Market Development Lead** 




 Location: Bahrain
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time
 



 Reports to: Head of Market Development
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Beyon Connect is seeking a commercially driven Market Development Lead to own and progress growth opportunities across its digital platforms.
 



 Reporting to the Head of Market Development, the role is responsible for managing assigned accounts, qualifying and advancing pipeline opportunities, driving sector activation, and contributing directly to revenue growth across priority industries. The successful candidate will lead client engagement, shape commercial propositions, progress qualified opportunities through the sales cycle, and ensure effective transition from commercial discussions to execution and delivery.
 



 This is a client\-facing commercial role within a high\-profile digital organization, suited to someone who combines structured thinking, strong relationship\-building skills, commercial discipline, and the ability to move opportunities from identification through to revenue realization.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities:** 




  





**1\.Account Ownership and Pipeline Development** 



* Own and manage selected client accounts within assigned sectors.
* Identify, qualify, and progress new commercial opportunities in line with business priorities.
* Maintain a disciplined view of account activity, pipeline status, next steps, and revenue potential.
* Lead structured client discussions and follow\-through across defined opportunities.
* Drive deal progression by coordinating internal inputs, resolving blockers, and maintaining momentum.
* Ensure opportunities are properly qualified, commercially viable, and aligned to strategic priorities.
* Contribute directly to revenue growth through account development, cross\-sell, upsell, and new opportunity conversion.



  





 2\.
 **Sector Activation and Commercial Execution** 



* Execute sector growth plans across priority industries and client segments.
* Translate sector opportunities into actionable account plans, commercial proposals, and delivery pathways.
* Develop pricing models, commercial frameworks, and business cases to support deal progression.
* Prepare commercial positioning, proposal, and negotiation materials.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth transition from commercial agreement to operational execution.
* Track progress against agreed commercial actions, client commitments, and delivery milestones.



  





**3\.Market Insight and Opportunity Structuring** 



* Conduct structured market, client, and competitive analysis to identify growth opportunities.
* Translate regulatory, sector, and industry dynamics into practical commercial recommendations.
* Assess client needs and align Beyon Connect solutions to relevant use cases and business outcomes.
* Support the development of sector\-level propositions that can be scaled across multiple accounts.
* Provide clear updates on pipeline movement, account priorities, and revenue opportunities to senior stakeholders.



  





**What We’re Looking For:** 



* Demonstrated experience in business development, account management, commercial strategy, consulting, project management, or client\-facing commercial roles.
* Strong understanding of pipeline management, opportunity qualification, and deal progression.
* Ability to take ownership of accounts and drive commercial follow\-through independently.
* Analytical and financial modelling capability.
* Comfortable leading client discussions independently within defined commercial parameters.
* Structured thinking and clear communication skills.
* Strong execution discipline and ability to coordinate across internal and external stakeholders.
* Experience in regulated industries preferred.
* Fluency in Arabic and English.



  





**Profile:** 



* Commercially minded, client\-focused, and growth\-oriented.
* Accountable for pipeline movement, client follow\-through, and revenue contribution.
* Comfortable operating between commercial strategy and hands\-on execution.
* Able to build trusted relationships with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Structured, proactive, and able to maintain momentum across multiple opportunities.
* Interested in developing long\-term sector expertise.



  





**Why Join Us:** 



* Direct exposure to sector\-level growth, client development, and nationally significant digital initiatives.
* Active ownership of accounts, pipeline opportunities, and commercial execution.
* Opportunity to contribute directly to revenue growth across regulated industries.
* Close collaboration with senior commercial leadership.
* High\-impact role within a fast\-growing and strategically important organization.

Be Part of a Legacy Bigger Than the Game
 



  





 At Al\-Qadsiah Club we’re creating more than teams—we’re crafting a legacy that goes beyond the game, making an impact both on and off the field. Driven by ambition, synergy, and innovation, we aim to inspire generations while shaping the future of Saudi sports.
 



  





 This is more than just a job—it’s an opportunity to be part of something larger than yourself. At Al\-Qadsiah, you’ll play a key role in shaping our legacy, contributing to the nation’s sports vision, and making history every step of the way.
 



  





  





**Overview:** 




  





 As the Individual and Unit Coach at Al\-Qadsiah Club, you will specialise in developing the technical abilities and individual behaviours of Academy players across multiple age groups. You will play a key role in delivering individual development programmes aligned with the club’s game model, supporting both player progression and overall team performance.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Leadership and Management** 




  




* Collaborate with the Head of Individual Development to deliver the Academy’s Individual Development Model
* Support the planning and delivery of monthly training programmes across age groups with clear development objectives
* Contribute to the ongoing evolution of individual development practices within the Academy



  





**Individual Development and Coaching** 




  




* Deliver high\-quality individual and small group coaching sessions focused on technical development and behaviour
* Design and deliver position\-specific and unit\-based training aligned to the Qadsiah Game Model
* Support players across all Academy age groups (U13–U21\) in their individual development journeys
* Provide targeted feedback during team training sessions to support individual player progression



  





**Analysis and Performance Support** 




  




* Lead the design and delivery of video analysis sessions for individual and small group development
* Maintain and develop a library of training sessions and best practice content using club platforms (IterPro, Hudl, SportsCode)
* Collaborate with the Performance Analysis department to enhance player development resources



  





**Collaboration and Player Development** 




  




* Contribute to Individual Development Plans and player performance reviews
* Work closely with multidisciplinary staff across the Academy to support holistic player development
* Engage with coaching staff to ensure alignment between individual and team objectives



  





  





**Qualifications** 




  





**Desirable:** 




  




* AFC Pro License or UEFA equivalent
* FIFA Guardian safeguarding qualification
* Skills, Knowledge and Experience:



  





**Essential** 
 :
 



  




* AFC A License or UEFA equivalent
* Proven experience coaching elite academy players
* Strong understanding of individual player development across different age groups
* Ability to deliver structured and targeted individual coaching sessions
* Experience working collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams
* Strong communication skills and ability to engage players effectively
* Proactive and structured approach to problem\-solving
* Comfortable working within a new cultural and professional environment
* Fluency in English



  





**Desirable:** 




  




* Experience using performance and analysis platforms such as IterPro, Hudl, and SportsCode
* Multilingual capability, including Arabic or Spanish
* Previous experience as a professional footballer Experience working in the Middle East
* Strong leadership and teamwork experience



  





  





**Why Join Al\-Qadsiah?** 




  





 Be Part of the Legacy: Join a club that’s redefining the future of Saudi sports, striving to lead the competition and set new standards of excellence.
 



  





 Experience the Culture: Thrive in an environment that values quality, accountability, diversity, synergy, innovation, and ambition, while embracing harmony—this is the Qadsiah Way.
 



  





 The Executives in Sport Group are retained on behalf of Al Qadsiah SC to make this appointment. All direct applications and CVs will be forwarded to The Executives in Sport Group.
 



  





**If this role is of interest, then please press the apply button and include a copy of your CV.**

data.jd_text:
**About Keyrock**
 Since our beginnings in 2017, we've grown to be a leading change\-maker in the digital asset space, renowned for our partnerships and innovation.
   

  

 Today, we rock with over 180 team members around the world. Our diverse team hails from 42 nationalities, with backgrounds ranging from DeFi natives to PhDs. Predominantly remote, we have hubs in London, Brussels and Singapore, and host regular online and offline hangouts to keep the crew tight.
   

  

 We are trading on more than 80 exchanges, and working with a wide array of asset issuers. As a well\-established market maker, our distinctive expertise led us to expand rapidly. Today, our services span market making, options trading, high\-frequency trading, OTC, and DeFi trading desks.
   

  

 But we’re more than a service provider. We’re an initiator. We're pioneers in adopting the Rust development language for our algorithmic trading, and champions of its use in the industry. We support the growth of Web3 startups through our Accelerator Program. We upgrade ecosystems by injecting liquidity into promising DeFi, RWA, and NFT protocols. And we push the industry's progress with our research and governance initiatives.
   

  

 At Keyrock, we're not just envisioning the future of digital assets. We're actively building it.
   

  

**Mission statement**
 The
 **Tech Lead** 
 plays a pivotal role in bridging
 **business objectives** 
 with
 **technical execution** 
 . This role is not purely managerial nor solely individual contributor, but a
 **hybrid position** 
 that combines

This is a rare, standalone appointment offering unparalleled direct access and genuine influence at the very centre of a high\-profile in
data.jd_text:
We are seeking an exceptional Finance Director to serve as the principal financial confidant and strategic adviser within a dynamic entrepreneur's Private Office. This is a rare, standalone appointment offering unparalleled direct access and genuine influence at the very centre of a high\-profile individual's business and personal financial world.
 



  





**The Role** 




 Embedded within the Private Office and reporting exclusively to the principal, you will serve as the financial backbone of a fast\-moving entrepreneurial operation — spanning a diverse portfolio of business interests, personal wealth, and investment assets including property and tangibles. This is not a corporate finance role. You will operate with full independence from all existing business lines, acting as the principal's most trusted financial voice: candid, proactive, and wholly aligned to his interests.
 



  





 You will be an exceptionally competent accountant and expected to think and act like a true business partner — anticipating needs, identifying risks and opportunities, and bringing genuine commercial instinct to every interaction.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Act as the principal financial adviser across all private office matters, business interests, and personal wealth
* Own the consolidation and interpretation of financial data across a complex, multi\-entity portfolio — translating it into clear, actionable intelligence for the principal
* Provide proactive, commercially sharp advice on tax planning, cash management, and capital allocation
* Monitor performance across the portfolio, flagging issues and opportunities with candour and speed
* Oversee financial governance, reporting cadences, and controls appropriate to a private entrepreneurial structure
* Support deal evaluation, acquisitions, and new ventures as they arise — the principal moves quickly and expects his Finance Director to move with him
* Maintain absolute confidentiality and discretion across all matters at all times



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) with substantial post\-qualification experience (min 10 years), ideally with exposure to private office, family office, or entrepreneurial environments
* A genuine entrepreneurial mindset — you thrive in ambiguity, move at pace, and are energised rather than unsettled by a principal who operates across multiple ventures simultaneously
* Proven experience providing financial counsel directly to a business owner, principal, or UHNW individual — not just reporting upwards within a large organisation
* Deep familiarity with complex, multi\-entity financial structures; comfortable across both corporate and personal financial matters
* Exceptional analytical capability combined with the judgement to know what matters and the confidence to say so plainly
* Outstanding interpersonal skills — this role demands a trusted relationship with a highly successful, highly demanding individual; you must be direct, reliable, and easy to work alongside
* Unimpeachable discretion; the handling of sensitive personal and commercial information is central to this role
* Self\-directing and highly organised — you will set your own agenda and be held accountable for outcomes, not activity

 The Head of Operational Excellence is responsible for establishing and embedding a sustainable culture of continuous improvement across the Group’s diverse business verticals including trading \& manufacturing, engineering, automotive, power solutions, financial services, office automation, car rental, and leasing etc. The role carries a Group\-wide mandate and is positioned to deliver measurable improvements in operational efficiency, quality, customer experience, financial performance, and overall Group competitiveness. The Head of Operational Excellence will collaborate closely with respective MDs and Divisional Heads to assess existing operational processes and implement best\-in\-class strategies and frameworks tailored to each division’s operational requirements and challenges.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop and execute the Group’s Operational Excellence strategy, roadmap, and governance framework.
* Lead the deployment of Lean, Six Sigma, and Kaizen methodologies across business units to drive efficiency, quality, sustainable cost optimization, and cross\-functional operational synergies.
* Partner with executive leadership and business heads to identify transformation priorities and translate them into measurable business outcomes.
* Build, develop, and mentor a high\-performing Operational Excellence team, supported by a network of internal change agents and certified practitioners.
* Define and monitor performance indicators, benchmark against industry best practice, and report progress, risks, and transformation outcomes to senior management through effective governance and performance reporting mechanisms.
* Lead change management, capability development, and the institutionalisation of best practices Group\-wide.

SaaS Business Unit Manager
 



  





 Sales, Growth, Customer Success \& Operations
 



  





**About the Company** 




  





 We are an established technology company in Kuwait with several years of market experience, a growing base of more than 600 business customers, and strong relationships with leading local and international partners.
 



  





 The company operates in the business technology sector, providing software, SaaS, payment\-related solutions, hardware, and digital business tools for SMEs and enterprise clients. The SaaS business unit is already active in the market and is now entering a new growth stage that requires stronger structure, leadership, sales execution, customer success, and scalable operations.
 



  





 This is not a role to build something from zero. It is an opportunity to lead and scale an existing business line with real customers, proven demand, market credibility, and strong growth potential.
 



  





  





  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We are looking for a strong, hands\-on SaaS Business Unit Manager to lead the growth and daily operations of our SaaS product in Kuwait.
 



  





 This is a key leadership role for someone who can combine B2B sales, growth execution, customer onboarding, customer success, technical support operations, team building, and process management.
 



  





 The right candidate will take ownership of the SaaS business unit and help build it into a scalable, well\-organized, and high\-growth operation.
 



  





  





**Why Join Us** 




  





 This is not a narrow sales or operations role. It is an opportunity to lead and grow a complete SaaS business unit with direct impact on revenue, customer experience, team structure, and market expansion.
 



  





 You will work closely with senior management, have clear ownership, and play a central role in building the company’s SaaS growth engine in Kuwait.
 



  





  





 1\. Role Objective
 



  





 Lead the full commercial and operational performance of the SaaS business unit, including sales, growth, marketing coordination, onboarding, customer success, technical support, team management, and daily execution.
 



  





 The goal is to build a scalable SaaS operation with clear ownership, structure, and measurable performance, allowing senior management to focus on strategic partnerships, major deals, and product development.
 



  





  





  





 2\. Sales \& Revenue
 



  





 Own sales targets, pipeline management, lead follow\-up, demos, closing activities, renewals, and revenue growth.
 



  





 Build and manage a structured sales process, improve conversion rates, train the sales team, and ensure full CRM discipline.
 



  





  





 3\. Growth \& Marketing
 



  





 Coordinate with marketing to generate qualified leads through campaigns, offers, content, landing pages, WhatsApp messages, and sector\-specific promotions.
 



  





 Measure marketing impact based on lead quality, conversion rate, customer acquisition, and revenue generated.
 



  





  





 4\. Customer Onboarding
 



  





 Manage the full onboarding journey from contract signing to go\-live.
 



  





 Create clear onboarding checklists, assign responsibilities, reduce activation delays, and ensure customers start using the system properly.
 



  





  





  





 5\. Customer Success \& Retention
 



  





 Ensure customer satisfaction, product adoption, renewals, upselling, and churn reduction.
 



  





 Monitor customer issues and usage patterns, identify at\-risk customers early, and build proactive follow\-up processes.
 



  





  





  





 6\. Technical Support Operations
 



  





 Organize daily technical support operations, ticket handling, issue classification, escalation rules, response time, and resolution follow\-up.
 



  





 Coordinate between customers, support staff, technical teams, and management to ensure fast and professional support.
 



  





  





  





 7\. Team Management
 



  





 Plan, hire, train, and manage the required sales, onboarding, customer success, and support teams.
 



  





 Set KPIs, monitor performance, improve discipline, and build a culture of accountability, teamwork, and customer service quality.
 



  





  





  





 8\. Operations \& Processes
 



  





 Build and improve SOPs for sales, onboarding, support, reporting, internal coordination, and customer follow\-up.
 



  





 Reduce operational chaos, dependency on individuals, and create a scalable operating system for the SaaS business.
 



  





  





  





 9\. Product \& Market Feedback
 



  





 Collect feedback from customers, sales, onboarding, and support teams.
 



  





 Organize product improvement requests and coordinate with the development/product team based on business impact, customer value, and scalability.
 



  





  





  





 10\. Reporting \& KPIs
 



  





 Prepare weekly and monthly reports covering sales, MRR, pipeline, onboarding, support, churn, renewals, complaints, team productivity, and operational risks.
 



  





 Track key KPIs including leads, demos, closed deals, conversion rate, onboarding time, support tickets, response time, resolution time, customer satisfaction, and churn.
 



  





  





  





 11\. Authority \& Execution
 



  





 The manager has the authority to prepare business plans, growth plans, sales plans, operational plans, hiring needs, tools, systems, and required resources.
 



  





 Once approved by senior management, the manager has full authority and responsibility to execute the approved plan and manage daily operations within the approved scope.
 



  





  





  





 12\. Required Experience
 



  





 Strong experience in B2B sales, preferably in SaaS, software, POS, fintech, payments, or business technology.
 



  





 Minimum 5 years of experience in the Kuwaiti market is required, with strong understanding of SMEs, restaurants, retail, and local customer behavior.
 



  





  





  





 13\. Language Requirement
 



  





 Fluency in both Arabic and English is mandatory.
 



  





 The candidate must communicate professionally in both languages with customers, teams, partners, vendors, and senior management.
 



  





  





  





 14\. Required Skills
 



  





 Strong sales leadership, operational discipline, customer success mindset, problem\-solving, follow\-up, reporting, and team management skills.
 



  





 The ideal candidate is organized, data\-driven, commercially strong, customer\-focused, and able to build processes and teams from scratch.

**Quality Assurance**

**Team Leadership**

**What You'll Have**

* Experience:
+ Minimum 15 years total experience
+ Minimum 5 years in oil \& gas / refinery / petrochemical industries
+ Minimum 5 years in a similar Project Engineering / Construction Management role

* Proven experience:
+ Managing multi\-disciplinary construction projects
+ Acting as deputy to a Projects Manager
+ Delivering complex environmental/remediation projects

* Demonstrated expertise in:
+ Soil remediation technologies and execution strategies

* Middle East project experience (highly desirable)


**About You**
 You are a proactive and results\-driven leader with the ability to manage complex projects and diverse teams. You bring:
   

  

* Strong technical expertise and problem\-solving abilities
* Excellent stakeholder and client engagement skills
* A structured and strategic approach to project delivery
* Passion for sustainability and environmental restoration
* You will be recognized as a subject matter expert, capable of guiding teams, resolving complex challenges, and delivering high\-impact outcomes.


**Why Join Worley on KERP?**
* Work on one of the world’s largest environmental remediation programs
* Contribute to meaningful sustainability and environmental recovery initiatives
* Be part of a globally recognized engineering and project delivery organization
* Lead impactful, large\-scale projects with long\-term significance


**Moving forward together**
 We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels they belong, can bring themselves, and are heard. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by law.
   

  

 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.
   

  

 Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

 Director of Operations

 Full\-time
   

  

* Kuwait City Reporting to: General Manager


**About Becurious Preschool**
 https://becurious.odoo.com/jobs/director\-of\-operations\-47
   

  

 BeCurious is a premium Finnish\-method preschool operating across three branches in Kuwait — Salam, Shuhada, and Salwa. Founded on the principle that curiosity is the most powerful force in early childhood learning, BeCurious has built a proprietary curriculum framework, a structured operating system, and a community of families who choose us for the quality of thinking behind everything we do.
   

  

 We are growing. We are building. And we are looking for the person who will run the engine.
   

  

**The Role**
* The Director of Operations is the operational backbone of BeCurious.
* This is not a coordination role. It is not a support role. The DOO is the person who makes sure that every session in every branch is delivered at the BeCurious standard — consistently, day after day, across all three locations.
* The DOO sits between the General Manager (who sets direction and owns the brand) and the Branch Supervisors (who run daily operations). Everything that matters operationally flows through this role.
* This role is right for you if you have a genuine love for early childhood education, a precise and organized mind, and the ability to hold a high standard without rigidity. You must be comfortable holding people accountable with warmth — not through fear, and not by doing their job for them.


**Responsibilities**
* Operations — Three Branches, One Standard:
* Own the daily operational standard across all three branches — Salam, Shuhada, and Salwa.
* Conduct monthly Branch Reviews with each Branch Supervisor (08\.1\) — reviewing KPIs, flagging patterns, agreeing action plans.
* Ensure every SOP in the BeCurious OS is being followed at branch level — and escalate deviations immediately.
* Manage the scheduling system — session allocation, teacher assignment, Home Preschool routing during continuity periods.
* Own the Feedback Log (08\.4\) — capture, categorize, and respond to all feedback across branches.
* Lead the Quarterly SOP Review (08\.2\) with the GM — identifying what is working, what needs updating, what needs a rebuild.
* Ensure branch readiness for Ministry inspections at all times — not just before announced visits.


**Team And Teaching Quality**
* Line manage Branch Supervisors — three direct reports. Support them. Challenge them. Hold them to the standard.
* Ensure all teaching staff are progressing through the Teacher Training Framework (02\.1\) at the required pace for their role.
* Conduct or coordinate classroom observations at minimum once per quarter per branch (03\.8 Classroom Observation Guide).
* Own the teacher evaluation process (04\.3\) — ensure evaluations are completed on schedule and that feedback leads to action
* Identify teaching staff who are ready to grow and flag them to the GM. Identify those who are struggling and build a support plan.
* Ensure no teacher leads a session alone without completing the required training stage for their role.


**Admissions And Enrollment**
* Own the admissions pipeline across all branches in Odoo — lead stages, conversion rates, follow\-up discipline.
* Oversee the Admissions Coordinator role — review their performance, support their work, escalate decisions that require GM involvement.
* Monitor enrollment capacity across branches — flag when a branch is approaching capacity or running below target.
* Ensure every family completing a tour receives a structured follow\-up within the required SOP timeframe.
* Review lead\-to\-tour and tour\-to\-enrollment conversion rates monthly — identify patterns and surface them to the GM.


**Curriculum And Learning Quality**
* Ensure monthly theme plans are submitted by Lead Teachers on schedule and reviewed before the month begins.
* Ensure weekly planning documents (03\.3\) are completed and filed — not treated as optional paperwork.
* Monitor child observation records (03\.7\) for consistency and quality — flag teachers who are not completing them.
* Ensure the Curiosity Lens Framework is visible in classroom practice — not just in documentation.
* Coordinate with the GM on curriculum development priorities for the year.


**Governance And Reporting**
* Attend the Weekly Leadership Meeting every Monday — present the Weekly Scorecard (09\.3\) and surface decisions that require GM input.
* Ensure the OS Change Log (00\) is updated whenever an SOP, template, or standard is modified.
* Manage incident documentation — ensure every incident has a completed 07\.5 Incident Report filed within 24 hours.
* Maintain the staff register in Odoo — civil IDs, health certificates, first aid certifications current for all staff at all times.
* Support the GM in preparing for the Annual Blueprint Review (08\.3\) — compiling the years evidence and identifying structural questions.


**What This Role Is Not**
* The DOO does not teach classes. This is a leadership and operational role.
* The DOO does not bypass Branch Supervisors to manage teachers directly — the chain of command is respected in both directions.
* The DOO does not make brand decisions — that is the GM's domain. The DOO executes brand standards. They do not change them.
* The DOO does not have financial signing authority above the limits in the authority matrix (04\.0\). Spending decisions above those limits go to the GM.
* The DOO's job is to make the standard work at scale. Not to be liked by everyone. Not to avoid difficult conversations. To make BeCurious excellent, consistently, across three branches.


**You Are The Right Person If**
**You will thrive in this role if you** 
 \|
 **This role is not right for you if you:**
* Have genuine experience in early childhood education or school operations — at least 4 years \| Are looking for a purely administrative or desk\-based role.
* Have managed a team before and understand that management means accountability, not friendship \| Expect to be liked by everyone you hold to a standard.
* Are organized to a degree that other people find remarkable — you track details without being reminded \| Find systematic documentation burdensome rather than protective.
* Can hold a high standard with warmth — you challenge people without humiliating them \| Prefer to avoid difficult conversations until they become crises.
* Are bilingual Arabic\-English — you operate at full professional quality in both languages \| Cannot communicate fluently and professionally in Arabic.
* Believe that curiosity in children is worth protecting — this is not a generic school for you \| See early childhood as a stepping stone to a different field.
* Understand that a system is what makes quality scalable — and you want to build that system \| Prefer to rely on improvisation and personal judgment over documented process.


**Required**
**Qualifications and Experience:**
* Minimum 4 years of experience in early childhood education, preschool management, or educational operations.
* Demonstrated experience managing a team — minimum 3 direct reports.
* Bilingual Arabic and English — professional fluency in both.
* Practical experience with a school management system (Odoo, Brightwheel, or equivalent).
* Based in Kuwait or able to relocate immediately — this is a full presence role across three branches.


**Strongly Preferred**
* Bachelor's degree in Early Childhood Education, Educational Leadership, or Business Administration.
* Experience with Finnish or play\-based education methodology.
* Experience leading or contributing to a curriculum quality review process.
* Experience with the Kuwait Ministry of Social Affairs licensing and inspection process.
* Demonstrated track record of improving operational consistency in a multi\-site environment.


**What BeCurious Offers**
**What You Get \| Detail:**
* A real leadership role \| Not a coordinator title with manager responsibilities. The DOO has genuine authority and is expected to use it.
* A built operating system \| BeCurious has a documented OS — SOPs, templates, review cycles, governance. You are inheriting a system and improving it. You are not building from nothing.
* Direct access to the founder \| Weekly leadership meeting with the Strategic Head and General Manager. Your voice shapes what BeCurious becomes.
* A curriculum you can believe in \| The Curiosity Lens Framework is a genuine educational philosophy. This is not a franchise curriculum or a generic play programme.
* Compensation \| Competitive, commensurate with experience. Discussed at the offer stage.
* Growth \| As BeCurious grows — more branches, Club, Camp — the DOO role grows with it. The person who builds the operational foundation at this stage has a significant role in the next one.


**How to Apply?**
 Send your CV and a short cover note (no more than one page) to the BeCurious HR Lead. In your cover note, answer one question: 'What does operational excellence look like in an early childhood setting, and how have you contributed to it?'
   

  

 We do not require a formal cover letter. We require a genuine answer to that question. Applications without a response to the question will not be reviewed.
   

  

 Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
   

  

* First stage: written review of CV and cover note.
* Second stage: structured conversation with the General Manager.
* Third stage: structured conversation with the Strategic Head.
* Final stage: offer and reference check.


 We move fast for the right person.
   

  

**About Emerge General Contracting Company**
 BeCurious is a Finnish\-inspired, play\-based preschool in Kuwait where children learn by doing, imagining, and exploring. We create joyful, inclusive classrooms and partner closely with families to help every child feel seen and thrive. As a team member, you’ll design hands\-on learning experiences, nurture curiosity and character, and work within a warm, supportive culture that celebrates each child’s uniqueness. If you’re caring, creative, and collaborative, you’ll feel right at home with us.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**Department: Center of Continuing Education**
**Reports to:** 
**Director \- CCE**
**Scope And Purpose**
 Center for Continuing Education (CCE) is committed to providing a wide range of professional development courses, training workshops, certificate programs, and customized corporate training solutions designed to meet the needs of individuals, businesses, and the community. By partnering with international certifying bodies and industry experts, the Center ensures that its programs are globally relevant, innovative, and aligned with labor market demands.
   

  

 The Training Operation Officer supports the effective delivery of CCE programs and training services by managing daily operational, logistical, and administrative processes. This role ensures that classes, instructors, and facilities are efficiently scheduled and prepared, that quality standards are consistently maintained, and that all post\-training documentation and reports are accurately completed. Working closely with the Team leader \- Training operation \& testing and the CCE Director, the training operations officer plays a key role in ensuring a seamless learning experience for participants and operational excellence across all CCE activities.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
* Coordinate Training Operations: Plan and manage the scheduling and setup of CCE training programs, ensuring all logistical, technical, and material requirements are met.
* Administer CCE Systems, Data, and Operational Schedules: Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records within CCE’s management systems, including product sheets, class openings, participant and instructor data, and operational reports. Develop and monitor the annual training calendar, trainers’ schedules, and classroom allocations to ensure effective resource management, operational efficiency, and accurate reporting.
* Monitor Quality and Service Standards:Oversee training delivery and gather feedback from participants and instructors to uphold CCE’s quality benchmarks.
* Support Instructors and Participants:Communicate essential course information, coordinate instructor schedules, and provide responsive support to ensure a positive learning experience.
* Oversee Facilities and Logistics:Ensure training venues, equipment, and course materials are properly arranged and maintained to create an effective learning environment.
* Maintain Administrative Efficiency:Process course\-related forms, certificates, cancellations, and transfers promptly to ensure compliance and smooth program operations.
* Manage Testing Center Operations: Coordinate scheduling, setup, and supervision of CCE testing activities, ensuring proper administration of exams, adherence to testing protocols, and maintenance of a secure and professional testing environment.
* Process Trainer Payments and Financial Requisitions: Prepare and process trainer payment requests \& handle BC petty cash advances.


**Qualifications**
**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Education, Management Information Systems, or a related field is required.


**Experience**
* Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in training administration, program coordination, or operation management, preferably within a university, continuing education, or professional training enviroment.
* Demonstrated experience managing trainign logistics, scheduling course setup, and reporting systems.
* Experience with testing center operations,including exam scheduling, supervision, and compliance with testing protocols, is highly desirable.


**Key Competencies**
* Administration: Effectively plans and coordinates tasks, resources, and schedules to ensure smooth execution of training and testing activities.
* Quality Management: Maintains high standards of accuracy and thoroughness in all operational and administrative processes.
* Applying Technology: Demonstrates proficiency in CCE systems, digital tools, and IT processes required for training delivery and reporting.
* Process Excellence: Understands, follows, and improves operational workflows to enhance efficiency and service quality.
* Information and Data Management: Collects, organizes, and analyzes data to generate accurate reports that support decision\-making and performance tracking.
* Office Management: Manages physical and digital resources—such as training rooms, materials, and equipment—to ensure readiness and proper utilization.
* Communication Skills: Communicates clearly, respectfully, and effectively with colleagues, trainers, and learners to foster collaboration and understanding.
* Service Orientation: Demonstrates commitment to providing high\-quality service to internal and external stakeholders through responsiveness and professionalism.
* Accountability: Takes ownership of responsibilities, delivers on commitments, and ensures consistent performance and dependability.
* Teamwork: Works cooperatively with others across departments to achieve shared goals and support organizational effectiveness.
* Adaptability: Responds positively to change, adjusting priorities and approaches to meet evolving operational and institutional needs.
* Self Management: Seeks opportunities to enhance personal effectiveness, update knowledge, and contribute to process improvement within the CCE.


**Certifications (preferred)**
* Project Management certification.
* Training Administration or Learning Management Systems (LMS)certification.
* Customer Service or Quality Management certification.
* Information Technology proficiency certification.

**About BeCurious**
 BeCurious is a premium Finnish\-method preschool operating across three branches in Kuwait — Salam, Shuhada, and Salwa. Built on the belief that curiosity drives learning, BeCurious combines a strong curriculum with a structured operating system.
   

  

 Each branch must operate at the same standard — every day, in every classroom. The Branch Manager is the person who makes that real on the ground.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Branch Manager owns the day\-to\-day operation of one BeCurious branch.
   

  

 This is not a coordination role. It is not administrative oversight. The Branch Manager ensures that every session, every teacher, and every family experience meets the BeCurious standard — consistently, without exception.
   

  

 You are responsible for execution. What is designed at system level must work in your branch — through people, discipline, and attention to detail.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Daily Operations — One Branch, Full Standard:
   

  

* Own the daily running of the branch from opening to closing.
* Ensure all sessions run on time and to standard.
* Execute all SOPs exactly as designed in the BeCurious OS.
* Maintain a clean, safe, and fully prepared environment at all times.
* Ensure readiness for inspections at any time.


**Team Management**
* Manage all teachers and support staff within the branch.
* Lead daily briefings and ensure team alignment.
* Hold staff accountable to performance standards.
* Support teacher development through coaching and feedback.
* Ensure no teacher leads a session without required training completion.


**Teaching \& Classroom Quality**
* Monitor classroom delivery daily.
* Conduct regular classroom observations.
* Ensure lesson plans and weekly planning are completed and followed.
* Ensure child observation records are completed properly.
* Maintain visible application of the Curiosity Lens Framework.


**Parent Experience**
* Ensure a high\-quality, consistent parent experience.
* Handle parent concerns professionally and promptly.
* Ensure proper communication standards are followed.
* Support tours and convert interest into enrollment in coordination with Admissions.


**Admissions Support**
* Support branch\-level enrollment targets.
* Ensure tour readiness and professional delivery.
* Follow up with prospective families when required.
* Maintain accurate information flow to the admissions system.


**Inventory \& Supplies**
* Monitor branch\-level inventory and usage.
* Coordinate with Purchasing Manager for supply needs.
* Ensure materials are available and organized for all sessions.
* Reporting \& Compliance.
* Report daily and weekly updates to Director of Operations.
* Maintain accurate records (attendance, incidents, staff data)
* Ensure incident reports are completed within required timelines.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements.


**What This Role Is Not**
* The Branch Manager does not operate without structure — SOPs are followed, not reinvented.
* This is not a passive supervisory role — you are actively managing every day.
* The Branch Manager does not avoid accountability conversations.
* This role is not about being liked — it is about maintaining standards.


**You Are The Right Person If**
 You will thrive in this role if you:
   

  

* Are highly organized and present on the floor.
* Can manage people with clarity and firmness.
* Pay attention to detail others miss.
* Take full ownership of outcomes, not excuses.
* Can maintain energy and consistency every day.


**This Role Is Not Right For You If You**
* Prefer planning over execution.
* Avoid difficult conversations with staff or parents.
* Struggle with structure and process discipline.
* Need constant direction instead of taking ownership.


**Required**
**Qualifications and Experience:**
* Minimum 3–5 years experience in education, preschool, or operations.
* Experience managing a team.
* Strong organizational and leadership skills.
* Arabic and English proficiency.
* Based in Kuwait or able to relocate immediately.


**Preferred**
* Experience in early childhood education.
* Experience in a structured, multi\-branch environment.
* Familiarity with school systems (Odoo, Brightwheel, etc.).


**What BeCurious Offers**
* A clear operating system — you execute with clarity, not guesswork.
* A real leadership role at branch level.
* Direct impact on children, families, and team quality.
* Growth as the organization expands.
* Compensation.
* Competitive, based on experience. Discussed at offer stage.


**How To Apply**
* Send your CV and a short note answering:
* “What does a high\-performing branch look like in a preschool, and how have you contributed to it?”
* Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

* Curiosity builds everything.


**About Emerge General Contracting Company**
 BeCurious is a Finnish\-inspired, play\-based preschool in Kuwait where children learn by doing, imagining, and exploring. We create joyful, inclusive classrooms and partner closely with families to help every child feel seen and thrive. As a team member, you’ll design hands\-on learning experiences, nurture curiosity and character, and work within a warm, supportive culture that celebrates each child’s uniqueness. If you’re caring, creative, and collaborative, you’ll feel right at home with us.

data.jd_text:
The job holder will be responsible for participating and leading all retail project / site development phases from schematic design through construction, including conceptual and detailed planning, designing, material specification, contractor evaluation and finalization, site supervision and control. The job holder will also be responsible for renovation and maintenance of existing stores with regards to any civil, electrical, mechanical, plumbing and carpentry works.
 



  





**Qualifications**




  




* Graduate Degree in Architecture/ Planning \& Design/ Applied Science / Civil Engineering
* Knowledge of spaces, spatial layouts, relations, conceptual sketching, 3D modelling
* Knowledge of Architectural detailing, Construction Methodology and Civil work estimation
* Knowledge in AutoCAD, 3D Max, Photoshop usage
* Exposure to the latest building materials, building systems and interior trends through formal or informal training (on\-the\-job experience)
* 7\-8 years of Interior / Retail Store / Building designing and Project Management experience



  





**Key Responsibilities**




  





**Retail Format Design / Re\-design** 



* Conceptualize / Redesign retail formats for the Concept in line with the customer, mall requirements and latest market trends
* Develop complete design for the showroom that will include a comprehensive floor plan, exterior elevations, interior elevations, A/c diffuse allocation, lightning, graphic imaging (3D Presentation) and all material selections and finishes
* Develop designs for all other features / utilities of the Mall or store such as building placement / orientation, parking lot layout / flow, service vehicle access
* Deliver detailed specifications and clear, concise, comprehensive, and complete engineering / interior drawings as required
* Ensure that all the designs and drawings are as per the company standards
* Develop the zoning in the store as per the categories of products to be displayed by bearing in mind the principles of space management and profiles of the target consumers
* Review and process all shop drawing/sample submissions and consult within the Projects Team and External Consultants, as appropriate, to ensure the design intent is being maintained
* Conduct existing conditions surveys and prepare architectural base plans, sections, elevations and details as appropriate to document relevant conditions
* Coordinate with the Retail Operations and VM team to get their inputs on the design, which includes the floor plan, elevations etc.
* Provide expertise in detail development and assisting in researching products and systems that accomplish the design intent
* Review and recommend to the retail team any changes that may be required to renovate the existing stores



  





**Site Project Management** 



* Assist in site selection and prepare the detailed survey report by performing on\-site design services, interpreting drawings, specs, codes, standards, regulatory requirements, and carrying out field engineering work
* Prepare detailed project plans for site development including project costing, timelines and development schedules and coordinate for approvals
* Nominate, evaluate and appoint consultants and contractors / suppliers / vendors including negotiation of rates and contractual terms and obligations
* Manage vendor relationships including conducting planning session with vendors and service providers and define project and performance expectations
* Identify and evaluate new products / solutions including material to be used bearing in mind quality and cost effectiveness
* Provide material specifications and oversee procurement of the material from suppliers
* Coordinate with external agencies like Architectural Consultants, Material suppliers, Construction agencies etc so as to ensure that the project is completed with in the scheduled time period in a efficient and effective way
* Supervise all the activities on\-site and coordinate with Concept to regularly provide feedback on the progress of work/project
* Guide and manage the manpower deployed onsite including Supervisors and contractor labour



  





**Technical Supervision** 



* Oversee and manage:
* Any construction and interior design related work in the existing stores and new stores
* Any electricity related work in the existing stores and new stores
* Any carpentry related work in the existing stores and new stores
* Any plumbing related work in the existing stores and new stores
* Review Civil / MEP (Mechanical Electrical Plumbing) drawings till completion
* Coordinate with MEP, municipal authorities and PRO for approvals of Civil signage’s and municipality permissions



  





**People Management** 



* Manage the performance of the team – set annual performance goals, monitor performance and provide constructive feedback to improve performance.
* Identify their training and development needs and ensure their fulfilment
* Develop and mentor subordinates to move to the next higher level of job through career planning
* Ensure compliance to Company policies and values



  





**Miscellaneous** 



* Keep oneself abreast about new shop fittings / elements and suggest material to be used
* Build and share knowledge of the latest retail design trends and computer aided technologies available

data.jd_text:
**Citi Country Officer \& Banking Head (CCO) Kuwait\- Director
   

  

 (Kuwaiti nationals encouraged to apply)**
 Citi was amongst the first foreign banks to establish presence on the ground in Kuwait in 2006, with deep routed relationships with the state dating back to the 1950s. The business in Kuwait is an Institutional Clients Group (ICG) franchise supported by circa 35 employees in country. The business activity covers the Public Sector, Private Sector, and Financial institutions with well\-developed client relationships.
   

  

 The Citi franchise in Kuwait will be part of the newly formed Middle East and Pakistan Sub\-Cluster. This new Sub\-Cluster is positioned to cover a geography with significant wealth and appetite for investments locally and globally. The Kuwait CCO \& BH, along with the rest of the Middle East and Pakistan Sub\-Cluster CCOs, will report directly to Middle East and Pakistan Sub\-Cluster Head.
   

  

 The Citi Country Officer \& Banking Head is the face of Citi in the country, playing the crucial role of leading and protecting the Citi franchise. In both leading the business and protecting the franchise, the CCO \& BH must achieve collaboration and alignment across all stakeholders – effectively managing a large matrix team.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Franchise Management in terms of developing and executing Citi’s overall client’s and business strategy to achieve both short and long\- term goals in compliance with corporate standards and local regulations.
* Ensuring compliance with all corporate policies, including ethical standards, corporate governance standards and business practice requirements.
* Applying judgment in understanding issues and making sound decisions that support, confirm, and enhance Citi's mission and vision.
* Identifying, assessing, mitigating, communicating, and anticipating all types of risks through the development and sustainability of appropriate control mechanisms.
* Overseeing, and escalating as necessary, the resourcing requirements of the legal entity to perform its governance, risk management and compliance obligations and reporting material risks / issues affecting the legal entity to the appropriate governance committees.
* Exhibit efficient and effective leadership that touches all parts of the franchise and provides a strong role model.

* In partnership with HR, executing Citi’s Talent agenda and overseeing franchise\-wide Talent review and development activities.

* Lead the Sustainability agenda and the digital transformation for clients with particular emphasis on digital natives and digital tools.

**About The Opportunity**
 قائد/ة مشروع — تكييف المعايير المرجعية لتقييم الذكاء الاصطناعي للسياق الخليجي
   

  

 نبحث عن قائد/ة مشروع لإدارة فريق من الخبراء الخليجيين في تطوير محتوى تقييمي عالي الجودة باللغة العربية الفصحى الحديثة.
   

  

 LILT adapts benchmarks into Modern Standard Arabic for the GCC market. Tasks are delivered as: an Arabic task statement, a scoring rubric, human \& LLM submissions, scores, and a gold solution. The output includes published datasets and research papers.

data.jd_text:
**Role Overview:** 




  





 As the CVM Lead, you will be the strategic and operational heartbeat of our Managed Services delivery for a leading telecom operator in Kuwait. You will lead a high\-performing team to design, execute, and optimize Customer Value Management (CVM) strategies using Evam’s real\-time marketing technology.
 



  





 The ideal candidate possesses a rare blend of MarTech expertise, data\-driven marketing strategy, and enough technical depth to understand complex event\-driven architectures. You will ensure that marketing goals are met through sophisticated automation, personalization, and real\-time customer engagement.
 



  





***This role is initially based in Istanbul or can be performed remotely from another country, with a planned on\-site relocation to Kuwait in a later phase, subject to regional conditions.***




  





**Job requirements:** 




  





**Experience:** 
 8\+ years in CVM, Direct Marketing, or MarTech roles, preferably within the Telecommunications or Banking sectors.
 



**MarTech Mastery:** 
 Deep understanding of Marketing Automation tools, CDP (Customer Data Platforms), and real\-time decisioning engines (Evam experience is a major plus).
 



**Technical Literacy:** 
 Familiarity with SQL, data structures, and the logic of real\-time streaming/event processing. You don't need to be a developer, but you must "speak the language."
 



**Analytical Mindset:** 
 Proficiency in interpreting complex data sets to drive marketing ROI.
 



**Leadership:** 
 Proven track record of managing managed services teams or agency\-side account teams in a high\-pressure environment.
 



**Communication:** 
 Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal). Ability to present complex technical solutions as clear business value to C\-level stakeholders.
 



  





**Job responsibilities:** 




  





**1\. Strategic Leadership \& Client Management** 




 Act as the primary point of contact for CVM and Marketing departments, aligning Evam’s capabilities with the client's commercial KPIs (ARPU growth, churn reduction, and upsell).
 



 Define the roadmap for real\-time marketing use cases, ensuring a balance between "always\-on" triggers and tactical campaigns.
 



 Lead and mentor the Managed Services team, fostering a culture of excellence and proactive value creation.
 



**2\. MarTech \& Campaign Excellence** 




 Oversee the end\-to\-end lifecycle of CVM campaigns: from hypothesis and segment definition to execution and post\-launch analysis.
 



 Utilize MarTech know\-how to implement advanced customer journeys, A/B testing frameworks, and multi\-channel orchestration (SMS, Push, App, Web).
 



 Drive the transition from traditional batch marketing to real\-time, event\-based engagement.
 



**3\. Technical Supervision** 




 Bridge the gap between marketing requirements and technical implementation. You must be comfortable discussing data schemas, API integrations, and logic flows with technical engineers.
 



 Ensure the Evam platform is configured optimally to handle large\-scale data streams.
 



 Troubleshoot campaign logic and performance bottlenecks alongside the DevOps and Engineering teams.
 



**4\. Analytics \& Optimization** 




 Monitor campaign performance in real\-time, providing actionable insights.
 



 Champion a data\-first approach, using CLV and behavioural data to refine targeting strategies.

data.jd_text:
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace \- shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data\-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast\-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand \- this is the team for you.
   

  

**The Role**
 We’re looking for a Head of Account Management to join our Kuwait team. In this role, you’ll be leading Deliveroo’s Account Management team, tasked with managing Kuwait’s best restaurants and chains, and developing the partnerships we have with restaurant partners. You will be joining one of the fastest\-growing start\-ups globally, surrounded by a top\-notch team of enthusiastic self\-starters who are passionate about delivering a fantastic service and contributing to the exciting journey that Deliveroo is on.
   

  

 This role requires an aggressive sales individual who can build solid relationships with all types of personalities in the F\&B industry. It will also require the person to be able to lead, develop, mentor, and coach a large team of managers and associates. Ultimately, this person is responsible for maintaining and expanding our market leadership and solidifying our restaurant relationships.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
 Here’s what your day\-to\-day might look like:
   

  

* Lead our Account Management strategy in Kuwait
* Facilitate and lead meetings with high\-profile F\&B groups for new business, renegotiations, or relationship management;
* Own relationships with key restaurant industry stakeholders, with a focus on building relationships and increasing profitability
* Build up Deliveroo’s image and reputation as an established and valued leader in the Kuwaiti F\&B industry
* Managing a large portfolio of restaurants, driving restaurant performance through data analysis and industry knowledge to maximise order volume and growth potential
* Coordinate with cross\-functional departments to engage support for activities aimed to drive business growth and ensure operational efficiency (Marketing, Operations, Customer Service, Corporate)
* Manage a team of talented account managers
* Motivate the team to meet aggressive targets
* Represent Deliveroo in F\&B industry events
* Adhere to internal processes to streamline administrative support
* Build up Deliveroo’s image and reputation as an established and valued leader in Kuwait’s F\&B industry.


**What You'll Need To Thrive**
 Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
   

  

* 5\+ years of work experience
* You’ll be a self\-starter, capable of driving yourself to your team's targets.
* Strong analytical and organisational skills
* Strong sales skills and track record of account management success
* History of exceeding revenue targets
* Recent experience leading a team
* Strong knowledge of the restaurant industry is a plus
* Experience in a high\-growth business environment or start\-up is a plus
* You must be outgoing and a strong communicator, whether face\-to\-face, through phone, or via email
* Excellent attention to detail
* Demonstrate experience using Microsoft Office tools and related project/program management applications to drive best practices
* Fluent in English and Arabic


**Why Join Us?**
 At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real\-world problems in a three\-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.
   

  

 We’re Food Lovers, Problem Solvers, Community Builders And More, Brought Together By a Shared Drive To Make Things Better. Working Here You Can Expect To
   

  

**🔧 Make a visible impact every day**
 Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.
   

  

 🌱
 **Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment**
 Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.
   

  

**🧠 Build a career, not just a role**
 Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.
   

  

**🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture**
 Collaborative, values\-driven teams that support how you work best.
   

  

 We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3\-4 stages. Find more about how we hire
 **here.**
**Our Global Structure**
 Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
   

  

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**
 At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
   

  

 We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio\-economic background, religion, or belief.
   

  

 If you have a disability or long\-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
   

  

 If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast\-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

**JOB PURPOSE:** 




 The
 
 Manager – Information Security will be responsible for managing FAB Kuwait’s Information Security, Business Continuity and Data Privacy Program. He/She serves as the process owner of the appropriate second\-line functional activities related to confidentiality, integrity, availability of Information assets in addition to Data Privacy and Buiness continuity as well third party risk management and physical security in compliance with regulatory requirements.
 



  





 The role will report directly to the Head of Risk – Kuwait and functionally to the Head of International Information Security at the Group, and shall be responsible to plan, implement, monitor and review the information security program for FAB Kuwait in consultation with Group Information Security Office – Head office team. The Manager – Information Security shall ensure the information security program, Data Privacy program and Business Continuity Management Program is in alignment with the regulatory, legal and statutory requirements of FAB Kuwait and the business strategy. The Manager – Information Security role will be operating out of the FAB Kuwait branch.
 



  





**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:** 



* Review and Maintain Information Security, Buisness Contnuity and Data Privacy Policies, Standards, and Procedures for FAB Kuwait.
* Participate in discussions and coordinate activities between local business units, support functions, Compliance Team, IT and GSO – HO for information security and Data Privacy, related planning, implementations and review.
* Ensure compliance as per regulatory requirements (all Information Security / Bsiness Continuity/ Personal Data Protection specific regulations applicabe to FAB Kuwait / Third party risk management / Physical security .).
* Provide regular reporting on the status of information security program, initiatives, security \& technology risks and relevant incidents to the executive management.
* Laise with external agencies such as regulatory/advManager \- Information Securityry/law enforcement bodies, as necessary, to ensure that the FAB Kuwait maintains a strong security posture and is kept well abreast of relevant threats identified by these agencies.
* Review new regulatory legislations; promptly communicate all regulatory notices/circulars to all concerned areas, provide interpretations if necessary; develop/monitor action plans towards its implementation.
* Assist Head office during Regulatory Examinations; ensure implementation/regularization of observations linked to compliance while meeting the deadline(s).
* Review Technology Risk Assessments for IT Projects, RCSA , Third party and Facility Risk assessments.
* Assist and support for Internal and External Audits. Monitor and track all open infosec issues with IT and concerned stakeholders.
* Oversee the tracking and closure of Security, BCM \& Privacy related Audit findings of FAB Kuwait.
* Govern the security awareness program for FAB Kuwait staff and customers.
* Provide support to FAB CSIRT and Group Data privacy for information security incident response and personal data breach handling.
* Provide SLOD oversight and support the business unit on the implementation of business continuity program in line with local regulatory requirements and Group BCM framework practices and RACI.
* Coordination with Business units/Fraud Risk / GSO for digital forensic investigation.
* Review and assess the regulatory circulars/notices, discuss with GSO\-HO and enforce security controls as applicable.
* Assist Group Information Security Office– Head Office team in delivery of information security services to the branch such as vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, SOC monitoring etc.
* Review Management Dashboards/Security MIS related to Patching, VA, PT, Baselines and end point security controls and highlight risks to the branch executive management.
* Assess and Review Change Requests and Security Exceptions for FAB Kuwait.
* Review BRDs, Solution Design, Product Papers from Information Security, Data Privacy and Busines Continuity perspective and any other requirements for FAB Kuwait business units.
* Review and track compliance for Data Privacy and Protection controls.
* Review KPI and KRI for country information security processes.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE:** 



* Information Security or IT Security or IS Audit background.
* Must be having a minimum 8 years of Information Security Experience.
* Expert knowledge of Information Security Domains and should be certified (CISA, CISSP or CISM or any other relevant security certification).
* Experience in a similar type of role in a multinational business and dealing with regulatory authorities, governments and industry bodies.
* Experience in managing security compliance teams.
* Knowledge of CBK regulatios on Cyber security, Business continuity, \& local privacy regulations.
* Ability to comply with Data Privacy Policy / procedures, draft / update local Data Privacy Polcies. Review local Business initiatives and SOPs where required, for compliance with Data Privacy Compliance requirements in co\-ordination with H.O. Teams.
* Ability to make good judgments regarding security risk and to prioritize resources and activity around managing those risks.
* Able to conduct the role independently and with integrity.
* Ability to plan, organize and prioritize tasks and projects.
* Good personal communication skills capable of dealing with wide range of stakeholders, including senior management.
* Fluent (spoken and written) in English, Arabic.
