**PURPOSE OF THE JOB** 




  





 • The Director of Project Management reports to the Chief Development Officer and works in close partnership with the Director of Development. The Director of Project Management is responsible for the delivery of all residential, non\-residential buildings and infrastructure (civil and landscape) works for the development.
 



 • The role requires development of short and long term planning for delivery of the project business plan. Monthly forecasting and monitoring of progress of works (cost time and quality) to handover is required to ensure cash and revenue projections are achieved.
 



 • Bring together, direct and manage all PM staff, contractors and consultants with clear briefing and management for all works, demonstrating a strong presence on site as a “hands on” leader.
 



 • Control time, cost, quality and health and safety via clear direction and management tools (dashboards, programs, budgets, meetings) to ensure design intent is delivered, resulting in a positive customer experience combined with efficiency of operations.
 



 • Prioritise response to any direct requests or instructions given by Senior Shareholder representatives and ensure full resolution agreed with the Shareholder expeditiously, at all times in liaison with and sign off by the DM team of such process.
 



 • Develop Best Practice methodology in benchmarking and value engineering to ensure cost efficiency without jeopardizing initial development concepts/customer expectations at time of pre\-sales.
 



 • Review existing operations \& administrative systems \& streamline as required to optimize resource efficiency.
 



 • Prepare clear \& concise RFP’s consistent with budgets for consultant \& contractor selection process as necessary \& in liaison with DM team.
 



 • Lead \& report on WOW initiatives as relate to PM operations and Capex across development projects.
 



 • Working closely with the customer experience/FM teams and managing the aftercare team is essential to ensure a positive customer experience continues post\-handover.
 



 • Develop safety, sustainability \& innovation strategies and targets for each business plan year.
 



 • Report regularly, and with clarity and transparently at all times.
 



 • Manage internal audits to ensure that company procedures and policies are being followed and adhered to.
 



  





**PRIMARY DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Key Tasks** 




 • Manage delivery of all residential, non\-residential built form and infrastructure works.
 



 • Use, and develop where necessary, key processes and procedures to ensure monitoring and management of time, cost and quality for all projects.
 



 • Work in close cooperation with the Director of Development on design of all works and ensure the delivery of design intent is achieved.
 



 • Develop and manage budget for all costs to ensure KPI’s are achieved.
 



 • Work with CDO, development and finance teams to develop business plan strategy.
 



 • Forecast and manage handover of all works to ensure Business Plan cash flow and revenue projections are achieved on, or ahead of target.
 



 • Procure all services with clear and concise briefing, pre\-qualification, negotiation and appointment in line with company policies and procedures.
 



 • Focus on cash management of works to ensure the most efficient use of company\-wide CAPEX.
 



 • Ensure strategy of handover of works to FM is comprehensive and well planned starting at the concept design stage, to ensure seamless handover resulting in a positive customer experience.
 



 • Ensure supportive relationship with Customer Experience Team to enhance the customer experience at all touch points relative to the PM function.
 



 • HSE compliance to be in line with best practice to maintain/improve track record.
 



 • Risk management framework regularly updated and managed to avoid negative impacts and ensure efficient, financially and corporate compliance via transparent, sustainable and safe operations at all time.
 



 • Ensure approvals/licenses and other obligations are procured and adhered to for all works.
 



 • Develop a meeting framework to ensure clear briefing, direction and follow up of the PM team, contractors, consultants and liaison with other in house staff to meet agreed KPIs.
 



 • Provide clear, concise and transparent reporting and communication to senior management on a monthly basis, including weekly meeting and updates to CDO.
 



 • Ensure sustainability initiatives are developed and targets adhered to for the project.
 



 • Foster innovation within the team to achieve companywide innovation targets.
 



 • Develop and foster strong relationships with key government authorities, contractors and consultants to ensure smooth management and delivery of projects.
 



 • Foster motivation and develop a collaborative team environment where the Development Management \& Project Management teams work seamlessly.
 



  





**PERSON SPECIFICATION** 




**Education \& Experience** 




 • BSc in Project Management, Engineering, or related discipline.
 



 • 15\+ years of Middle East work experience in the development field, with the majority of experience being client\-side.
 



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 




  





**Functional Knowledge** 




 • Deep knowledge of built form and infrastructure within large scale/multiple project environments.
 



 • Strong understanding of development processes and procedures.
 



 • Strong understanding of customer needs and business value drivers.
 



 • Proficient in software applications such as AutoCAD, MS Project, MS Office, BIM, and related systems.
 



  





**Technical Competencies** 




 • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
 



 • Strong planning, organizational, and project management skills.
 



 • Strong analytical skills.
 



 • Strong budgeting and future planning skills.
 



  





**Management Competencies** 




 • Leads by example.
 



 • Team player.
 



 • Strong interpersonal relationship skills.
 



 • Initiative and proactive mindset.
 



 • Diplomacy and stakeholder management.
 



  





**Communication** 




 • Effective writing and reporting skills.
 



 • Ability to deliver presentations across a variety of situations and topics.
 



 • Strong relationship development and maintenance skills.
 



 • Strong internal communication capabilities.
 



 • Fluency in English, both verbal and written, is preferred. Fluency in Arabic would be advantageous but not essential.
 



  





**Core Values** 




 • Bold
 



 • Passionate
 



 • Togetherness

**Job purpose** 




 Lead and oversee the Corporate Planning \& Performance function within OQEP’s Finance stream, ensuring the development, consolidation, and delivery of integrated corporate planning, budgeting, and performance reporting frameworks that support strategic decision\-making and drive business performance across the organization.
 



  





 The position will act in accordance with the OQEP’s Mission, Vision, Values \& Strategies, as well as, policies, guidelines, and international standards, supported by an IT Technology platform, QHSE \& Energy Management System requirements standards, Omani’s government \& other legal justifications, and best international practices in consonance with national objectives.
 



  





**Main Tasks and Responsibilities** 



* Lead the development and continuous improvement of OQEP's integrated corporate planning framework, ensuring alignment between strategic objectives, financial plans, and operational targets across all business functions and streams.
* Oversee the annual corporate planning cycle including the preparation, consolidation, and submission of OQEP's Business Plan, Long\-Range Plan (LRP), and annual budget in coordination with all functions and asset teams.
* Direct the corporate budgeting process end\-to\-end, including budget guidelines issuance, consolidation of OPEX and CAPEX submissions, variance analysis, and executive\-level budget reporting.
* Lead the performance reporting function, ensuring the development and delivery of accurate, timely, and insightful management reports, dashboards, and scorecards for OQEP's executive leadership and Board.
* Oversee the development and maintenance of OQEP's corporate KPI framework, ensuring KPIs are aligned with strategic objectives, cascaded effectively across the organization, and tracked with appropriate rigor.
* Provide strategic financial insights and analytical support to VP Finance and the Executive Leadership Team to enable informed decision\-making on business performance, resource allocation, and strategic priorities.
* Lead the consolidation and analysis of mid\-year and quarterly reforecasts, highlighting performance gaps, risks, and opportunities and recommending corrective actions to leadership.
* Oversee benchmarking activities against industry peers and best practices to identify performance improvement opportunities and inform strategic planning assumptions.
* Ensure integration of corporate planning and performance management processes with OQ Group requirements, timelines, and reporting standards.
* Drive the digitalization and continuous improvement of planning and performance reporting tools, systems, and processes, leveraging advanced analytics, automation, and business intelligence platforms.
* Develop and maintain Corporate Planning \& Performance policies, procedures, standards, and governance frameworks in alignment with OQEP and OQ Group guidelines.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with functional heads, asset management teams, and OQ Group corporate functions to ensure coherent and aligned planning and performance management across OQEP.
* Lead, develop, and mentor the Corporate Planning \& Performance team, fostering a high\-performance culture and building capability within the department.
* Manage the Corporate Planning \& Performance department budget, ensuring efficient resource utilization and value delivery.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.



  





**Key interactions:** 




 Internal: Finance function, all OQEP business functions and streams, Operated Assets and Non\-Operated Assets functions, Executive Leadership Team.
 



 External: OQ Group Corporate Planning and Finance functions, external auditors and consultants, government ministries, benchmark and industry intelligence partners.
 



  





**Notable Working Conditions.** 
 Office environment, intensive computer screen use, occasional domestic and international travel.
 



  





**Education requirements:** 




**Required:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related field.
 



**Preferred:** 
 Postgraduate qualification (Master’s, MBA, CFA, CIMA, CA, or CPA); professional certifications in financial planning, performance management, or business analytics are an advantage.
 



  





**Language:** 
 Excellent knowledge of written, read, and spoken English (required) \| Arabic \- Native (desirable)
 



  





**Background and experience** 




  




* 10\+ years of relevant experience in corporate planning, financial planning \& analysis, budgeting, or performance management.
* Oil \& Gas / Energy industry experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading corporate planning and budgeting cycles at an organizational level.
* Proven track record of developing and delivering executive\-level performance reporting and KPI frameworks.
* Experience working with OQ Group or similar large integrated energy group planning processes is an advantage.
* Strong exposure to financial modelling, long\-range planning, and strategic scenario analysis.
* Previous leadership of multi\-disciplinary finance or planning teams.
* Experience with ERP and business intelligence platforms (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Power BI, Tableau) is preferred.



  





**Competencies and skills:** 




  





**Soft:** 




  




* People management and leadership.
* Strategic thinking and business\-oriented mindset.
* Strong communication, presentation, and influencing skills.
* Stakeholder management across all organizational levels including ELT and Board.
* Analytical and critical thinking.
* Change management and continuous improvement mindset.
* Attention to detail with ability to synthesize complex information into clear executive narratives.
* Cultural sensitivity in a multinational environment.



  





**Technical:** 




  




* Computer literacy including MS Office (advanced Excel and PowerPoint).
* Corporate financial planning and budgeting methodologies.
* Long\-range planning and scenario analysis.
* KPI framework design and performance management.
* Financial modelling and forecasting.

The role oversees business development strategy, client engagement, bid leadership, commercial negotiations, and partnership development while driving market positioning, revenue growth, and competitive advantage. The position also leads cross\-functional teams in structuring complex aviation and infrastructure deals, managing stakeholder relationships, supporting investment evaluations, and ensuring alignment with corporate governance, strategic objectives, and long\-term business growth initiatives.
 



  





**Key ACCOUNTABILITIES** 




**1\. Strategic Business Development \& Growth** 



* Lead the identification, prioritization, and pursuit of new business opportunities across airport consultancy, PPP concessions, and O\&M contracts
* Define and execute the business development strategy aligned with the growth ambitions of Oman Airports
* Build and manage a robust pipeline of opportunities across target regions, with a focus on emerging and high\-growth aviation markets
* Drive market entry strategies, including partnerships, joint ventures, and consortium formations



**2\. Opportunity Origination \& Client Engagement** 



* Establish and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders including governments, airport authorities, investors, and industry partners
* Proactively originate opportunities through market intelligence, networking, and strategic positioning
* Represent the organization in high\-level engagements, industry forums, and client meetings
* Position the company as a trusted advisor in airport development, operations, and optimization



**3\. Leadership of Bids, Proposals \& Commercial Strategy** 



* Oversee the end\-to\-end bid and proposal process for consultancy, PPP, and O\&M opportunities
* Provide strategic direction to the Proposal \& Bid Management team to ensure compelling, compliant, and competitive submissions
* Define win strategies, value propositions, and competitive positioning for each opportunity
* Ensure alignment between technical solutions, financial models, and commercial frameworks



**4\. PPP, O\&M \& Consultancy Deal Structuring** 



* Lead the structuring of complex PPP and concession opportunities, including commercial frameworks and risk allocation
* Guide the development of financial and commercial models in collaboration with finance teams
* Negotiate key commercial terms with clients, partners, and stakeholders
* Oversee the evaluation of investment opportunities, including strategic fit, risk profile, and expected returns



**5\. Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Team Management** 



* Lead and mentor multidisciplinary teams across business development, proposals, finance, legal, and technical functions
* Foster collaboration and alignment across internal departments to deliver integrated solutions
* Set performance targets, monitor outcomes, and drive accountability across the business development function
* Build internal capabilities in airport advisory, PPP structuring, and bid management



**6\. Market Intelligence \& Competitive Positioning** 



* Monitor global aviation trends, airport privatization programs, and competitor activities
* Provide strategic insights to senior leadership on market dynamics, risks, and opportunities
* Identify differentiators and continuously refine the company’s value proposition in consultancy and airport management
* Drive thought leadership initiatives to enhance brand positioning



**7\. Governance, Risk \& Performance Management** 



* Ensure all business development activities align with corporate governance, risk management, and compliance frameworks
* Oversee bid/no\-bid decisions based on strategic, financial, and operational considerations
* Track and report on pipeline performance, win rates, and revenue generation
* Ensure disciplined handover of won projects to operations and finance teams



**8\. Partnerships \& Ecosystem Development** 



* Identify, evaluate, and onboard strategic partners, advisors, and consortium members for major bids
* Lead relationship management with key partners across PPP and consultancy engagements
* Strengthen the organization’s ecosystem to enhance competitiveness in large\-scale international tenders



  





**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Aviation, Engineering, Business, or Economics; an MBA or equivalent advanced degree is strongly preferred.
* 10\+ years of leadership experience in airport operations, infrastructure, aviation strategy, with at least 5 years in leadership position or international role.
* Experience leading global airport concession bids, acquisitions, or major aviation infrastructure programs.
* Experience with emerging market operations, public\-private partnerships, and stakeholder engagement with governments or multilateral institutions.
* Understanding of commercial aviation services and airport ecosystems (ground services, retail, cargo, digital).

 A practical experience of no less than 6 to 12 years in project controls, including planning, cost, and progress monitoring.

* Earned Value Management, Integrated Project Controls Course.


**Languages Required:** 
 Excellent level in English language writing, reading, and speaking. Arabic is a plus.

**About Us**
 Tamara is the leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC region with a mission to help people make their dreams come true by building the most customer\-centric financial super\-app on earth. The company serves millions of users in the region and partners with leading global and regional brands such as SHEIN, Jarir, noon, IKEA and Amazon, as well as small and medium businesses.
   

  

 Tamara is Saudi Arabia’s first fintech unicorn and is backed by Sanabil Investments, a wholly owned company by the Public Investment Fund (PIF), SNB Capital, Checkout.com, amongst others. The company operates from its headquarters in Riyadh, with additional regional and global support offices.
   

  

**Your Role**
 This role requires you to be a Swiss Army knife. It'll engage every skill you have and make your brain cells perk up—left brain, right brain, and muscles you didn't know you had.
   

  

 If you're the type who enjoys building the plane while it's flying, this is your seat. We're a brand\-new comms department, inside a 1,000\-person scale\-up operating across multiple offices and time zones.
   

  

 There's structure where it matters and space to build it where it doesn't exist yet.You'll help shape how we work, not just execute what's already there.
   

  

 We're in charge of crafting the company's narrative and ensuring it's clear, consistent, and visible across all our stakeholders: customers, partners, media, talent, investors, regulators, and more.We're looking for a PMO Specialist to help run, coordinate, and deliver the work that keeps our Communications function moving forward.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
**Strategic Project Delivery:**
* Own end\-to\-end delivery: Lead high\-impact projects and special initiatives. You will drive timelines, manage complex stakeholder relations, and ensure high\-quality output across the board.
* Orchestrate complexity: Manage multiple parallel workstreams, ensuring tight alignment across cross\-functional partners (Product, Finance, Legal, etc.) and leadership.
* Agency \& Vendor Stewardship: Lead the analytical and negotiation process with agencies and vendors. You will work directly with agency owners to define scope, refine performance metrics, and ensure commercial alignment with our strategic goals.


**Strategic Planning \& Executive Influence**
* Drive planning cycles: Lead the operational aspects of annual planning, budgeting, and OKR processes. You will be responsible for the integrity of the data and the quality of materials presented to executive leadership and the CEO Office.
* Strategic facilitation: Proactively manage stakeholder alignment, ensuring clear communication and progress across the organization.


**Operational Excellence \& Architecture**
* Build and scale: Don’t just follow processes—architect them. You will identify gaps in our current operations and build scalable frameworks from scratch to improve team efficiency.
* Drive truth and transparency: Establish and enforce rigorous standards for documentation, tracking, and reporting that serve as the "single source of truth" for the department.


**Commercial \& Contract Rigor**
* Lead contract lifecycle: Take ownership of the coordination of agreements, NDAs, and vendor contracts, working closely with Legal and Finance to navigate complex procurement cycles.
* Financial stewardship: Proactively manage the financial health of the function, including budget tracking, billing, and vendor management, with high precision and autonomy.


**You'll Work Closely With**
* Internal teams (Finance, Legal, Product, IT, Design, HR)
* External agencies and vendors
* Executive leadership and the CEO Office


**Your expertise**
**Skills \& Experience**
* Strategic Project Leadership: Proven ability to manage competing priorities and complex stakeholder landscapes in a fast\-paced environment.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Demonstrated success working in diverse, high\-impact teams, with the ability to bridge gaps between different departments to drive collective progress.
* Exceptional Communication: Expert\-level written and verbal communication, with the ability to synthesize complex data into clear, persuasive narratives for senior leadership.


**Mindset**
* Owner Mindset: You take full ownership of your domain. You don’t wait for instructions to fix broken processes—you see them, you build the solution, and you own the outcome.
* Comfort with Ambiguity: You thrive in environments where the path isn’t clearly defined. You have a natural ability to create structure out of chaos.
* High\-Stakes Grit: You are ambitious, hungry to learn, and capable of working effectively across multiple priorities in a high\-pressure, fast\-moving business environment.


**Independent Driver:** 
 You are a self\-starter who can navigate complex organizational structures to push progress forward, even when resources are constrained.

data.jd_text:
**About Yellow Door Energy**
 Yellow Door Energy is the leading sustainable energy partner for commercial and industrial businesses across the Middle East and Africa. We deliver sustainable energy solutions through power purchase agreements and solar leases, helping businesses reduce energy costs, improve power reliability, and lower carbon emissions.
   

  

 Our solutions include solar PV, battery energy storage systems, hybrid energy, and energy efficiency. Our shareholders include Actis, Mitsui \& Co, TAEF, and the International Finance Corporation.
   

  

 🔍 About the Role
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Renewable Energy PV Project Manager – KSA** 
 to support the delivery of commercial and industrial solar PV projects across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Experience with
 **BESS or hybrid energy projects** 
 would be a strong advantage.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on project delivery role focused on the site\-based execution of solar PV projects from mobilisation, EPC and subcontractor coordination, progress tracking, and project controls through to quality inspections, commissioning, documentation, and handover.
   

  

 Working under the direction of the VP of Execution, you will act as YDE’s on\-site representative, ensuring EPC contractors deliver safely, on schedule, within budget, and in line with YDE’s technical, contractual, HSE, and quality standards.
   

  

 This role is best suited to a project professional with strong solar PV construction experience, practical engineering knowledge, and the discipline to manage daily site execution, contractor performance, project controls, variations, and reporting in a fast\-moving, site\-based environment.
   

  

 ⚡ What You’ll Deliver \& Own
   

  

 In this role, you will support the successful delivery of commercial and industrial solar PV projects across KSA, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and to YDE’s technical and quality standards.
   

  

**You Will**
* Drive day\-to\-day site execution, EPC and subcontractor coordination, progress tracking, and issue resolution.
* Translate approved PV designs, drawings, schedules, and project plans into contractor\-ready execution activities.
* Monitor EPC contractor and subcontractor performance, review look\-ahead schedules, challenge recovery plans, and maintain accurate site records.
* Support project controls and contract administration activities, including contractor payment application review, milestone tracking, variation inputs, and time/cost impact assessment.
* Track critical project controls, including RFIs, technical queries, drawing revisions, submittals, procurement dependencies, risks, costs, variations, and reporting.
* Support HSE leadership on site through toolbox talks, inspections, permit\-to\-work processes, incident reporting, and corrective action follow\-up.
* Conduct quality inspections at key hold points, including piling, racking, DC cabling, AC works, switchgear installation, and inverter commissioning.
* Support commissioning, punch\-list close\-out, handover documentation, and transition to Asset Management and O\&M teams.


 🛠️ What You Must Bring
   

  

**To Be Successful In This Role, You Must Have**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering preferred; Mechanical or Civil Engineering may also be considered.
* Minimum 8 years’ experience in project management or site engineering for EPC/construction projects.
* Minimum 3 years’ experience in solar PV or renewable energy projects.
* Hands\-on experience managing solar PV construction sites, including DC and AC electrical works, mounting structure installation, inverter commissioning, and grid interconnection.

data.jd_text:
**Position: Mobility \& Asset Control Specialist**
**Location: Riyadh**
**About CSI Global**
 CSI Global is a multi\-disciplinary engineering and contracting group delivering advanced
 **electromechanical, building MEP systems, testing and commissioning consultancy services, project management consultancy, contracting and construction solutions** 
 across the GCC and beyond. Through our group companies, we serve the power, utilities, and infrastructure sectors with full lifecycle capabilities from tendering and design review to execution, commissioning, and handover. We combine engineering precision with commercial excellence to power progress across complex projects in the region.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Mobility \& Asset Control Specialist will be responsible for coordinating workforce mobility across project sites in Saudi Arabia, including site access, mobilization, and demobilization in collaboration with HR and PMO teams. The role oversees accommodation and transportation arrangements while ensuring compliance with project and client requirements. Additionally, the position manages and monitors all lease contracts under company agreements. A key aspect of the role involves overseeing the full lifecycle of MEP assets, including electrical testing instruments, calibration tracking, vehicles, consumables, and high\-value materials across multiple project locations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Mobility \& Site Support
* Coordinate mobilization and demobilization of site personnel in alignment with HR and PMO requirements
* Manage accommodation requests, including allocation and room assignments for site staff
* Handle transportation arrangements for staff and equipment between project sites
* Ensure compliance with client and project\-specific entry and exit protocols
* Lease Contract Management
* Maintain and track all active lease contracts, including vehicles, site accommodations, offices, and equipment
* Monitor lease expirations, renewal timelines, and rental payment schedules
* Maintain an accurate and centralized lease register
* Coordinate with procurement and administration for timely contract renewals or terminations
* Asset \& Materials Management
* Manage inventory of electrical testing instruments and related equipment
* Maintain calibration schedules and track certification validity and timely renewals
* Coordinate with third\-party laboratories for equipment recalibration
* Implement and enforce check\-in/check\-out procedures for sensitive equipment
* Maintain a comprehensive asset register, including barcode tagging, location tracking, assignment status, and depreciation records
* Conduct periodic (monthly/quarterly) physical asset audits and report discrepancies, damages, or losses
* Manage vehicles, consumables, PPE, and MEP materials with defined min/max stock levels
* Maintain documentation for asset handovers, maintenance schedules, and calibration records
* Enforce asset security and custody protocols to prevent misuse or loss


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Logistics, or a related field (Diploma holders with relevant experience may be considered)
* 2–4 years of experience in asset management, mobility coordination, and inventory control, preferably within MEP or electrical testing services in KSA
* Proficiency in ERP systems such as SAP or Oracle, and advanced skills in Microsoft Excel
* Bilingual proficiency in Arabic and English


**Working Conditions**
* Hybrid role involving both office and site\-based responsibilities, including coordination with central warehouse operations
* Flexibility to support occasional weekend work for urgent mobilization, demobilization, or asset transfer requirements

**Job Description** 





 Technology Business Partner
 




  





**Role Purpose**




 The Technology Business Partner (TBP) is responsible for ensuring that
 **business strategy is translated into high‑value, secure, and compliant technology outcomes** 
 .
 



 The role acts as the
 **single point of accountability** 
 between assigned Business Units and Information Technology, owning technology demand, prioritization, and value realization.
 



  





**Organizational Context**



* **Function:** 
 Digital Systems \& Information Technology
* **Department:** 
 Digital Solutions \& Technology
* **Section:** 
 Business Solutions
* **Reports to:** 
 Section Head – Technology Business Solutions
* **Scope:** 
 Assigned Business Units (e.g. Retail, Corporate, International)



  





**Key Responsibilities**




 1\.
 
 Business Partnership \& Strategic Alignment
 



* Act as the primary technology advisor to assigned Business Units.
* Build strong relationships with senior business stakeholders.
* Understand business strategies, objectives, and challenges.
* Translate business needs into clearly defined and prioritized technology initiatives.
* Ensure alignment of all initiatives with business strategy, IT strategy, and digital roadmaps.



  





 2\.
 
 Technology Portfolio \& Investment Governance
 



* Own the technology portfolio for assigned Business Units.
* Lead prioritization of initiatives based on business value, ROI, risk, and capacity.
* Develop and evaluate business cases and cost‑benefit analyses.
* Support technology budgeting, investment planning, and resource allocation.



  





 3\.
 
 Delivery Oversight
 



* Oversee the end‑to‑end lifecycle of approved technology initiatives.
* Work closely with PMO, Project Managers, Business Analysts, and IT delivery teams.
* Ensure solutions are delivered on time, within scope and budget, and meet quality standards.
* Track KPIs, benefits realization, and adoption of digital solutions.



*Note: This role is accountable for outcomes, not hands‑on development or technical delivery.* 




  





 4\.
 
 Stakeholder \& Executive Management
 



* Facilitate decision‑making across business, IT, and governance forums.
* Manage competing priorities and expectations across multiple stakeholders.
* Communicate technology concepts clearly in business terms.
* Resolve conflicts and drive consensus on priorities and delivery plans.



  





 5\.
 
 Risk, Governance \& Compliance
 



* Ensure adherence to IT governance frameworks and bank policies.
* Partner with Risk, Compliance, and Information Security teams.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate technology‑related risks.
* Support audit, regulatory, and compliance requirements.



  





 6\.
 
 People Leadership
 



* Lead and develop Business Analysts and related team members.
* Allocate work, provide coaching, and manage performance.
* Build team capability in business analysis and value‑driven solution design.
* Support learning, development, and career progression.



  





**Key Interfaces**




**Internal:** 
 Business Units, Strategy, PMO, Digital Architecture, IT Security, Data \& Analytics, Application Delivery, Infrastructure \& Operations, Risk \& Compliance
 



**External:** 
 Vendors, Consultants, Service Providers, Regulators (as required)
 



  





**Experience \& Qualifications**





 Experience
 



* **10–18 years** 
 of experience in Banking / Financial Services.
* Proven experience in IT Business Partnering, technology portfolio management, or IT governance.
* Experience leading or managing Business Analysts, Project Managers, or cross‑functional IT teams.




 Education \& Certification
 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related discipline.
* Master’s degree (MBA / Technology Management) is an advantage.
* **PMP or PRINCE2 certification is mandatory.**



  






 Core Competencies
 



* Strategic and analytical thinking
* Strong business and financial acumen
* Stakeholder management and influence
* Portfolio and investment decision‑making
* Change and complexity management
* Risk awareness and governance focus
* High ethical standards and confidentiality



  





**Important Note:** 
 Banking experience is mandatory. Candidates with prior experience working as consultants on banking or financial services technology projects may also be considered, provided they have strong exposure to banking operations, regulations, and enterprise IT environments.

data.jd_text:
**About the Company**
 Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
   

  

 Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2\.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70\+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.
   

  

***We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem\-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.***
**The Mission**
 We believe the transformative potential of AI is significantly under\-realised in our region. To bridge this gap, we are incubating a new division within Careem dedicated to Enterprise AI Transformation.
   

  

 We are reimagining and building the future of work to simplify and improve how businesses function in the era of GenAI with WorkOS: a next\-generation ‘operating system’ designed to deploy, orchestrate, and improve AI agents across every customer and operational journey (and increasingly autonomously). This isn’t just automation; it’s about creating a hybrid workforce where self\-learning AI agents handle the heavy lifting, empowering our people to focus on the highest\-value, most creative work.
   

  

**The Team**
 This group operates as a startup within Careem with a distinct mandate: move fast, build boldly, and deliver production\-grade AI systems that fundamentally change how the region leverages technology.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for an exceptional founding Backend Engineer to build the WorkOS platform. This is a role for a systems\-thinker who wants to work at the intersection of high\-scale distributed systems and AI orchestration. You will be responsible for building the "brain" of WorkOS, the engine that deploys and manages autonomous agents across the region’s most complex operational journeys at massive scale.
   

  

 As one of the first engineers in WorkOS, you will have a disproportionate impact on our technical foundation, culture, and the speed at which we move from 0 to 1\.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Architect and Build the WorkOS Engine: Design and build the scalable backend services and architectures required to orchestrate complex AI workflows and real\-time data streaming. Leverage novel technologies to build cutting\-edge capabilities.
* Set the Engineering Gold Standard: As a founding member, you will establish our backend best practices, from CI/CD and observability to security and system integrity, ensuring a high\-velocity but rigorous engineering culture.
* Solve for Distributed Complexity: Navigate the unique challenges of integrating AI agents into legacy enterprise stacks, ensuring low\-latency communication and robust data consistency.
* Database design: Build our data infrastructure, leveraging relational, schemaless, and vector stores to power the platform and create persistent brains for our Agents.
* Full\-Cycle Ownership: Own the lifecycle of the platform, from rapid prototyping of new agent capabilities to maintaining production\-grade systems at enterprise scale.
* Drive AI\-Accelerated Engineering: Constantly experiment with AI\-assisted development to move faster than traditional teams, while maintaining a bar for superb technical quality and craft.
* Lead Pioneer Deployments: While building the core platform, you will occasionally lead the charge on first\-of\-their\-kind implementations for strategic partners, ensuring our tech solves real\-world operational complexity.
* Operate with High Agency: In this lean, startup\-style environment, you will be responsible for outcomes over inputs, rolling your sleeves up to code and balancing investments in the long\-term technical roadmap with the need to ship value quickly.


**What You’ll Need**
* 8–12\+ years of professional backend engineering experience, with significant tenure acting as a Staff Engineer or Technical Lead for complex, high\-scale distributed systems.
* Mastery of Backend Systems: Deep expertise in languages like Python, Go, or Node.js, with a proven track record of architecting concurrency, microservices, and high\-throughput data pipelines.
* AI\-Native Infrastructure Depth: Hands\-on experience with LLM orchestration (LangChain, etc.), vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus), and RAG architectures at a production\-grade level.
* Systems\-Level Visionary: The ability to design "platform\-first", thinking in terms of APIs, modularity, and extensibility so that the WorkOS core can support infinite customer use cases.
* Obsession with Performance: A specialist's focus on latency and system observability; you believe that AI interactions must feel "instant" and "bulletproof" to be valuable.
* Startup\-level Autonomy: Comfortable navigating a "0\-to\-1" environment where you define the technical roadmap and ship high\-quality code without a playbook.
* Willingness to work on\-site full time in UAE, to foster the high\-intensity collaboration required for this incubation phase.
* Experience with enterprise software transformation or legacy system integration is a significant plus.


**What You’ll Receive**
* A Blank Canvas and Live Ammunition: The rare opportunity to build a "0\-to\-1" product while immediately deploying it into the real\-world operations of a regional giant. No "sandbox" projects here, you’ll be shipping code that moves people and goods on day one. This is a huge opportunity to create impact in our region.
* Architecting the Engine: We’re a lean, impact\-obsessed team operating with total autonomy. You’ll be free from corporate bureaucracy and legacy baggage, focused entirely on building the core orchestration layer and agentic frameworks that will serve as the "brain" of the region’s enterprises.
* Direct Collaboration with Leadership: Direct engagement with Careem and enterprise client leadership, in addition to working side\-by\-side with the WorkOS founding team including Magnus Olsson (Careem’s original Co\-founder).
* Competitive Compensation: Including direct equity in this new division. Our philosophy is meritocratic: we want you to own a meaningful stake in the value you create.
